1.135.m: with the sixth pitcher filled with south-western water, / filled with water of all sacred fords and fragrant with lotus pollen;

1.135.s:
saptamenābhiṣiñcantu ṛṣayaḥ sapta ye varāḥ .
vasavaścābhiṣiñcantu kalaśenāṣṭamena vai . . 26
1.135.d:
सप्तमेनाभिषिञ्चन्तु ऋषयः सप्त ये वराः ।
वसवश्चाभिषिञ्चन्तु कलशेनाष्टमेन वै ॥ 26
1.135.m: with the seventh, may the seven supreme Ṛṣis consecrate you; / and may the Vasus indeed consecrate you with the eighth pitcher,

1.135.s:
aṣṭamaṅgalayuktena devadeva namo'stu te .
tato vai kalaśairdivyaiḥ snānakarma samārabhet . . 27
1.135.d:
अष्टमङ्गलयुक्तेन देवदेव नमोऽस्तु ते ।
ततो वै कलशैर्दिव्यैः स्नानकर्म समारभेत् ॥ 27
1.135.m: endowed with the eight auspicious things; obeisance to you, O god of gods!" / Then he should begin the rite of bathing with the divine pitchers.

1.135.s:
samudraṃ gaccha yaḥ prokto mantrametamudīrayet .
hiraṇyagarbheti ca yo mantrastaṃ samudīrayet . . 28
1.135.d:
समुद्रं गच्छ यः प्रोक्तो मन्त्रमेतमुदीरयेत् ।
हिरण्यगर्भेति च यो मन्त्रस्तं समुदीरयेत् ॥ 28
1.135.m: He should utter that mantra which is taught as "samudraṃ gaccha", / and the mantra which is "hiraṇyagarbha" he should utter.

1.135.s:
samudrajyeṣṭheti mantreṇa kṣālayenmṛttikānvitam .
sinīvālīti mantreṇa dadyādvalmīkamṛttikām . . 29
1.135.d:
समुद्रज्येष्ठेति मन्त्रेण क्षालयेन्मृत्तिकान्वितम् ।
सिनीवालीति मन्त्रेण दद्याद्वल्मीकमृत्तिकाम् ॥ 29
1.135.m: With the mantra "samudrajyeṣṭhāḥ", he should wash [the image] treated with earth; / with the mantra "sinīvālī", he should apply anthill earth.

1.135.s:
śamyudumbaramaśvatthaṃ nyagrodhaṃ ca palāśakam .
yajñaṃ yajñeti mantreṇa dadyātpañcakaṣāyikam . . 1.135.30
1.135.d:
शम्युदुम्बरमश्वत्थं न्यग्रोधं च पलाशकम् ।
यज्ञं यज्ञेति मन्त्रेण दद्यात्पञ्चकषायिकम् ॥ 1.135.30
1.135.m: Śamī, udumbara, aśvattha, nyagrodha, and palāśa: / with the mantra "yajñena yajñam", he should apply the decoction of five astringents.

1.135.s:
pañcagavyaṃ pavitraṃ ca āharettāmrabhājane .
gāyatryā caiva gomūtraṃ gandhadvāreti gomayam . . 31
1.135.d:
पञ्चगव्यं पवित्रं च आहरेत्ताम्रभाजने ।
गायत्र्या चैव गोमूत्रं गन्धद्वारेति गोमयम् ॥ 31
1.135.m: And he should bring the pure pañcagavya in a copper vessel: / cow urine with the Gāyatrī, and cow dung with "gandhadvārām";

1.135.s:
āpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāvṇeti vai dadhi .
tejo'sīti ghṛtaṃ tadvaddevasya tvā kuśodakam . . 32
1.135.d:
आप्यायस्वेति च क्षीरं दधिक्राव्णेति वै दधि ।
तेजोऽसीति घृतं तद्वद्देवस्य त्वा कुशोदकम् ॥ 32
1.135.m: milk with "āpyāyasva", curd indeed with "dadhikrāvṇaḥ", / ghee likewise with "tejo 'si", and kuśa water with "devasya tvā".

1.135.s:
evamādividhiyutaṃ pañcagavyaṃ prakīrtitam .
yā1 oṣadhīti maṃtreṇa snānamoṣadhibhiḥ kramāt . . 33
1.135.d:
एवमादिविधियुतं पञ्चगव्यं प्रकीर्तितम् ।
या1 ओषधीति मंत्रेण स्नानमोषधिभिः क्रमात् ॥ 33
1.135.m: Endowed with such rites, the pañcagavya is declared. / With the mantra "yā oṣadhīḥ", [there is] the bath with herbs in order.

1.135.s:
drupadābhiḥ punastasya kuryāccodvartanaṃ budhaḥ .
śiraḥ snānaṃ tato dadyānmānastokābhimantritam . . 34
1.135.d:
द्रुपदाभिः पुनस्तस्य कुर्याच्चोद्वर्तनं बुधः ।
शिरः स्नानं ततो दद्यान्मानस्तोकाभिमन्त्रितम् ॥ 34
1.135.m: Again, the wise man should perform its rubbing with the Drupadā verses; / then he should give the head-bath consecrated with "mā nas toke".

1.135.s:
viṣṇorarāṭamantreṇa dadyādgandhodakaṃ śubham .
tato nadyudbhavenaiva kṣālayecchuddhavāriṇā . . 35
1.135.d:
विष्णोरराटमन्त्रेण दद्याद्गन्धोदकं शुभम् ।
ततो नद्युद्भवेनैव क्षालयेच्छुद्धवारिणा ॥ 35
1.135.m: With the mantra "viṣṇor rarāṭam", he should offer auspicious scented water; / then he should wash it with pure water arising from a river.

1.135.s:
jātavedasamuccārya vastrapūtena vāriṇā .
tata āvāhayeddevaṃ raktamālyāmbaraṃ śubham . . 36
1.135.d:
जातवेदसमुच्चार्य वस्त्रपूतेन वारिणा ।
तत आवाहयेद्देवं रक्तमाल्याम्बरं शुभम् ॥ 36
1.135.m: Uttering the mantra to Jātavedas, with water strained through a cloth; / then he should invoke the auspicious god, adorned with red garlands and garments:

1.135.s:
ehyehi bhagavanbhāno lokānugrahakāraka .
yajñabhāgaṃ gṛhāṇārghyamarkadeva namo'stu te . . 37
1.135.d:
एह्येहि भगवन्भानो लोकानुग्रहकारक ।
यज्ञभागं गृहाणार्घ्यमर्कदेव नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 37
1.135.m: "Come, come, O Lord Bhānu, cause of favor to the world! / Accept your portion of the sacrifice and the arghya; obeisance to you, O god Arka!"

1.135.s:
hiraṇyena tu pātreṇa devāyārghyaṃ pradāpayet .
idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame mantreṇārghyaṃ samarpayet . . 38
1.135.d:
हिरण्येन तु पात्रेण देवायार्घ्यं प्रदापयेत् ।
इदं विष्णुर्विचक्रमे मन्त्रेणार्घ्यं समर्पयेत् ॥ 38
1.135.m: He should have the arghya offered to the god in a golden vessel; / with the mantra "idaṃ viṣṇur vicakrame", he should present the arghya.

1.135.s:
pārthivaiḥ prathamaṃ kalaśaiḥ snāpayedbhāskaraṃ budhaḥ .
tatastvaudumbarairvīra rājataistadanantaram . . 39
1.135.d:
पार्थिवैः प्रथमं कलशैः स्नापयेद्भास्करं बुधः ।
ततस्त्वौदुम्बरैर्वीर राजतैस्तदनन्तरम् ॥ 39
1.135.m: First, the wise man should bathe the Sun with earthen pitchers, / then with udumbara wood ones, O hero, and immediately after with silver ones;

1.135.s:
tatastu kāñcanairdevaṃ snāpayedyadunandana .
sarvatīrthajalairyuktaṃ sarvauṣadhisamanvitam . . 1.135.40
1.135.d:
ततस्तु काञ्चनैर्देवं स्नापयेद्यदुनन्दन ।
सर्वतीर्थजलैर्युक्तं सर्वौषधिसमन्वितम् ॥ 1.135.40
1.135.m: then he should bathe the god with golden ones, O joy of the Yadus, / combined with water from all sacred fords and endowed with all herbs.

1.135.s:
śaṅkhamādāya devasya tato mūrdhani śaṅkara .
dattvā puṣpāṇi devasya mūrdhni yatnādvicakṣaṇaḥ . .4 1
toyamutkṣipya yatnena tataḥ snapanamācaret .
prathamaṃ snāpayeddevaṃ vāriṇā yadunandana . . 42
1.135.d:
शङ्खमादाय देवस्य ततो मूर्धनि शङ्कर ।
दत्त्वा पुष्पाणि देवस्य मूर्ध्नि यत्नाद्विचक्षणः ॥4 1
तोयमुत्क्षिप्य यत्नेन ततः स्नपनमाचरेत् ।
प्रथमं स्नापयेद्देवं वारिणा यदुनन्दन ॥ 42
1.135.m: Taking a conch for the god, then [placing it] on the head, O Śaṅkara, / having carefully placed flowers on the god's head, the wise man, / tossing up water with care, should then perform the bathing rite. / First he should bathe the god with water, O joy of the Yadus,

1.135.s:
tatastu payasā rājanpāyasena tatastu vai .
ghṛtena madhunā vāpi tathā ikṣurasena ca . . 43
1.135.d:
ततस्तु पयसा राजन्पायसेन ततस्तु वै ।
घृतेन मधुना वापि तथा इक्षुरसेन च ॥ 43
1.135.m: then with milk, O king, then with milk-rice porridge, / with ghee, or with honey, and likewise with sugarcane juice.

1.135.s:
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya gomedhasya ca suvrata .
jyotiṣṭomasya rājendra vājapeyasya vai vibho . . 44
1.135.d:
अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य गोमेधस्य च सुव्रत ।
ज्योतिष्टोमस्य राजेन्द्र वाजपेयस्य वै विभो ॥ 44
1.135.m: Of the Agniṣṭoma sacrifice and the Gomedha, O one of good vows, / of the Jyotiṣṭoma, O lord of kings, and of the Vājapeya, O powerful one,

1.135.s:
rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ ghṛtādyairlabhate phalam .
yastu kārayate snānaṃ yastu bhaktyā prapaśyati3 . .
kriyamāṇaṃ tu devasya snānaṃ yadukulodvaha . . 45
1.135.d:
राजसूयाश्वमेधाभ्यां घृताद्यैर्लभते फलम् ।
यस्तु कारयते स्नानं यस्तु भक्त्या प्रपश्यति3 ॥
क्रियमाणं तु देवस्य स्नानं यदुकुलोद्वह ॥ 45
1.135.m: and of the Rājasūya and Aśvamedha, he obtains the fruit through ghee and the other [substances]. / But he who has the bath performed, and he who with devotion beholds / the bath of the god being performed, O promoter of the Yadu line,

1.135.s:
ya ete kathitā yajñā eteṣāṃ kramaśaḥ phalam .
arcāṃ ca kuruśārdūla dṛṣṭvā vai labhate phalam . . 46
1.135.d:
य एते कथिता यज्ञा एतेषां क्रमशः फलम् ।
अर्चां च कुरुशार्दूल दृष्ट्वा वै लभते फलम् ॥ 46
1.135.m: he obtains in succession the fruit of these sacrifices that have been spoken of; / and having seen the image, O tiger among the Kurus, he surely obtains the fruit.

1.135.s:
snānaṃ tu yatnataḥ kāryaṃ devadevasya suvrata .
yathā na laṅghayetkaściddevasya snapanaṃ vibhoḥ . . 47
1.135.d:
स्नानं तु यत्नतः कार्यं देवदेवस्य सुव्रत ।
यथा न लङ्घयेत्कश्चिद्देवस्य स्नपनं विभोः ॥ 47
1.135.m: The bath of the god of gods should be performed with care, O one of good vows, / so that no one may step over the bathing water of the lord,

1.135.s:
na prāśnanti yathā kākāstīrthaṃ lokavigarhitāḥ .
snānodakaṃ tu devasya athavā paya eva hi . . 48
1.135.d:
न प्राश्नन्ति यथा काकास्तीर्थं लोकविगर्हिताः ।
स्नानोदकं तु देवस्य अथवा पय एव हि ॥ 48
1.135.m: [and] so that crows, despised by the world, do not drink the water of the sacred bath, / namely the bath water of the god, or indeed the milk.

1.135.s:
bhūmau gataṃ yathā caiva prāśnāti yadunaṃdana .
rogaṃ prāpnoti kartā vai duḥkhaṃ kārayitā tathā . . 49
1.135.d:
भूमौ गतं यथा चैव प्राश्नाति यदुनंदन ।
रोगं प्राप्नोति कर्ता वै दुःखं कारयिता तथा ॥ 49
1.135.m:
And if it has fallen to the ground, O joy of the Yadus, and someone drinks it,
the performer indeed incurs disease, and likewise the patron incurs misery.

1.135.s: tasmādyatnena kartavyaṃ devasya snapanaṃ vibhoḥ . . 1.135.50
1.135.d: तस्माद्यत्नेन कर्तव्यं देवस्य स्नपनं विभोः ॥ 1.135.50
1.135.m: Therefore, the bathing of the almighty god should be carried out with great care.

1.135.s:
snāpayitvā krameṇetthaṃ snānakarma vidhānavit .
tato vardhanikāṃ gṛhya vāridhārāṃ samutsṛjet . . 51
1.135.d:
स्नापयित्वा क्रमेणेत्थं स्नानकर्म विधानवित् ।
ततो वर्धनिकां गृह्य वारिधारां समुत्सृजेत् ॥ 51
1.135.m:
Having thus bathed [him] in proper sequence, one knowing the rite of the bathing ritual
should then take a small pitcher and pour out a stream of water.

1.135.s:
trivārānpurato'rkasya ācamasveti ca bruvan . ve
dosīti ca mantreṇa upavītaṃ pravāpayet . . 52
1.135.d:
त्रिवारान्पुरतोऽर्कस्य आचमस्वेति च ब्रुवन् । वे
दोसीति च मन्त्रेण उपवीतं प्रवापयेत् ॥ 52
1.135.m:
Saying 'Sip water' three times before the sun,
he should offer the sacred thread with the mantra 'You are the Veda...'

1.135.s:
bṛhaspateti mantreṇa vastrayugmaṃ pradāpayet .
yatnakramaṃ prakurvāṇaḥ puṣpamālāṃ pradāpayet . . 53
1.135.d:
बृहस्पतेति मन्त्रेण वस्त्रयुग्मं प्रदापयेत् ।
यत्नक्रमं प्रकुर्वाणः पुष्पमालां प्रदापयेत् ॥ 53
1.135.m:
With the mantra 'O Bṛhaspati...', he should offer a pair of garments.
Proceeding with great care, he should offer a garland of flowers.

1.135.s:
dhūrasīti ca mantreṇa dhūpaṃ dadyātsaguggalam1 .
samiddhoñjanamantreṇa añjanaṃ tu pradāpayet . . 54
1.135.d:
धूरसीति च मन्त्रेण धूपं दद्यात्सगुग्गलम्1 ।
समिद्धोञ्जनमन्त्रेण अञ्जनं तु प्रदापयेत् ॥ 54
1.135.m:
With the mantra 'You are the yoke-pin...', he should offer incense along with bdellium.
With the mantra 'Kindled...', he should offer collyrium.

1.135.s:
yuñjānīti ca mantreṇa rocanāṃ tasya dāpayet .
ārārtikaṃ ca vai kuryāddīrghāyuṣṭvāya varcase . . 55
1.135.d:
युञ्जानीति च मन्त्रेण रोचनां तस्य दापयेत् ।
आरार्तिकं च वै कुर्याद्दीर्घायुष्ट्वाय वर्चसे ॥ 55
1.135.m:
With the mantra 'Yoking...', he should apply bright-yellow pigment to him.
And he should perform the waving of lamps for longevity and splendour.

1.135.s:
snānakarma tvidaṃ proktaṃ bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ .
bhojakā brāhmaṇāścaiva kriyāṃ kuryuḥ prayatnataḥ . . 56
1.135.d:
स्नानकर्म त्विदं प्रोक्तं भास्करस्य महात्मनः ।
भोजका ब्राह्मणाश्चैव क्रियां कुर्युः प्रयत्नतः ॥ 56
1.135.m:
This has been declared the bathing rite of the great-souled Bhāskara.
Bhojakas and brāhmaṇas should perform the rite with diligent effort.

1.135.s:
bahavṛco'tharvaṇaścaiva chandogodhvaryureva ca .
snāpakasya ca cihnāni ye ca mūrtidharāstathā . . 57
1.135.d:
बहवृचोऽथर्वणश्चैव छन्दोगोध्वर्युरेव च ।
स्नापकस्य च चिह्नानि ये च मूर्तिधरास्तथा ॥ 57
1.135.m:
Those of the Ṛgveda, Atharvaveda, Sāmaveda, and the Yajurveda;
and the marks of the bath-priest, as well as those who sustain the image—

1.135.s:
teṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi vibho śṛṇu caikamanāḥ kila .
sampūrṇagātro matimāñchāstrajñaḥ priyadarśanaḥ . . 58
1.135.d:
तेषां प्रवक्ष्यामि विभो शृणु चैकमनाः किल ।
सम्पूर्णगात्रो मतिमाञ्छास्त्रज्ञः प्रियदर्शनः ॥ 58
1.135.m:
I shall declare their [qualities], O mighty one; listen with an attentive mind:
having all limbs complete, intelligent, knowing the scriptures, of pleasing appearance,

1.135.s:
kulīnaḥ śraddadhānaśca āryadeśasamudbhavaḥ .
na sthūlo na kṛśo dīrghaḥ sauraśāstraviśāradaḥ . . 59
1.135.d:
कुलीनः श्रद्दधानश्च आर्यदेशसमुद्भवः ।
न स्थूलो न कृशो दीर्घः सौरशास्त्रविशारदः ॥ 59
1.135.m:
of noble family, faithful, born in the Āryan land,
neither stout nor lean, tall, skilled in the Saura treatises,

1.135.s:
yaśca yukto jitātmā ca gurubhakto jitendriyaḥ .
pañcaviṃśatitattvajñaḥ sthāpakaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ . . 1.135.60
1.135.d:
यश्च युक्तो जितात्मा च गुरुभक्तो जितेन्द्रियः ।
पञ्चविंशतितत्त्वज्ञः स्थापकः समुदाहृतः ॥ 1.135.60
1.135.m:
disciplined, self-controlled, devoted to the guru, master of his senses,
knowing the twenty-five principles—such an installer is commended.

1.135.s:
varjanīyāṃśca vakṣyāmi yaistu karma na kārayet .
hīnāṅgaścādhikāṅgaśca vāmano vikaṭastathā . . 61
1.135.d:
वर्जनीयांश्च वक्ष्यामि यैस्तु कर्म न कारयेत् ।
हीनाङ्गश्चाधिकाङ्गश्च वामनो विकटस्तथा ॥ 61
1.135.m:
And I will describe those to be avoided, by whom one should not have the rite performed:
one with a missing limb, one with a surplus limb, a dwarf, and one who is deformed,

1.135.s:
nātigauro na kṛṣṇaśca snāpanāya prayojayet .
cārvāko yājakaścaiva nityaṃ gomukhadambhakaḥ . . 62
1.135.d:
नातिगौरो न कृष्णश्च स्नापनाय प्रयोजयेत् ।
चार्वाको याजकश्चैव नित्यं गोमुखदम्भकः ॥ 62
1.135.m:
neither too fair nor [too] dark should one employ for the bathing;
a materialist, a mercenary priest, and one who is constantly a hypocrite hiding behind a mild exterior,

1.135.s:
aśucivratasaṃyuktaḥ śyāmadanto'tha matsarī1 .
kopano duṣṭaśīlaśca yuvā vā vṛddha eva ca . . 63
1.135.d:
अशुचिव्रतसंयुक्तः श्यामदन्तोऽथ मत्सरी1 ।
कोपनो दुष्टशीलश्च युवा वा वृद्ध एव च ॥ 63
1.135.m:
one given to impure observances, one with discoloured teeth, envious,
irascible, of wicked conduct, or [one too] young or very old,

1.135.s:
śvitrī kuṣṭhī ca rogī ca kāṇo durmatireva ca .
saṃkīrṇo jātihīnaśca tathā na vṛṣalīpatiḥ . . 64
1.135.d:
श्वित्री कुष्ठी च रोगी च काणो दुर्मतिरेव च ।
संकीर्णो जातिहीनश्च तथा न वृषलीपतिः ॥ 64
1.135.m:
one with leukoderma, a leper, a sick man, one-eyed, foolish,
of mixed caste, outcaste, and likewise not the husband of a Śūdra woman,

1.135.s:
kubjaścādhastathā vyaṃgaḥ khalvāṭo vikalendriyaḥ .
avinīto durātmā ca vikalaḥ paṅgureva ca . . 65
1.135.d:
कुब्जश्चाधस्तथा व्यंगः खल्वाटो विकलेन्द्रियः ।
अविनीतो दुरात्मा च विकलः पङ्गुरेव च ॥ 65
1.135.m:
hunchbacked, low-born, maimed, bald, defective in senses,
ill-mannered, wicked, disabled, and lame.

1.135.s:
tithinakṣatrayogānāṃ vārāṇāṃ ca tathā vibho .
sūcako jīvikārthaṃ3 hi yaśca mūlyena pāṭhayet . . 66
1.135.d:
तिथिनक्षत्रयोगानां वाराणां च तथा विभो ।
सूचको जीविकार्थं3 हि यश्च मूल्येन पाठयेत् ॥ 66
1.135.m:
One who announces lunar days, asterisms, conjunctions,
and weekdays for the sake of a livelihood, O lord, and one who teaches for a fee—

1.135.s:
īdṛśānsnāpakānsarvānvarjayeta prayatnataḥ .
tasmātsarvaprayatnena parīkṣyāḥ snāpakā budhaiḥ . . 67
1.135.d:
ईदृशान्स्नापकान्सर्वान्वर्जयेत प्रयत्नतः ।
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन परीक्ष्याः स्नापका बुधैः ॥ 67
1.135.m:
all such bath-priests one should diligently avoid.
Therefore, bath-priests must be tested with every effort by the wise.

1.135.s:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sāṃbopākhyāne
sūryapratiṣṭhāsnānavidhivarṇanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ . 135 .
sūryapratiṣṭhāvarṇanam
1.135.d:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे सांबोपाख्याने
सूर्यप्रतिष्ठास्नानविधिवर्णनं नाम पञ्चत्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः । 135 ।
सूर्यप्रतिष्ठावर्णनम्
1.135.m:
Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-fifth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Rite of Bathing in the Consecration of the Sun,' in the story of Sāmba, in the Seventh-Tithi Kalpa of the Brāhmaparvan in the glorious and great Bhaviṣyapurāṇa.
Description of the Consecration of the Sun

1.136.s:
nārada uvāca
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi adhivāsanamuttamam .
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣo maṇḍapaṃ yatnato viśet . . 1
1.136.d:
नारद उवाच
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि अधिवासनमुत्तमम् ।
सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषो मण्डपं यत्नतो विशेत् ॥ 1
1.136.m:
Nārada said:
After this, I shall describe the excellent preliminary consecration.
With 'The thousand-headed Puruṣa...', he should carefully enter the pavilion.

1.136.s:
tato'nye ca śucau deśe asaṃspṛṣṭopalepane .
maṇḍalaṃ pañcavarṇaistu ālikheccaturasrakam . . 2 patākātoraṇacchatradhvajamālyādyalaṃkṛtam .
vicitrasuvitānāḍhyaṃ prakīrṇakusumotkaraiḥ . . 3
1.136.d:
ततोऽन्ये च शुचौ देशे असंस्पृष्टोपलेपने ।
मण्डलं पञ्चवर्णैस्तु आलिखेच्चतुरस्रकम् ॥ 2 पताकातोरणच्छत्रध्वजमाल्याद्यलंकृतम् ।
विचित्रसुवितानाढ्यं प्रकीर्णकुसुमोत्करैः ॥ 3
1.136.m:
Then in another, clean place, where the smeared surface is untouched,
he should draw a four-cornered diagram with five colours, / decorated with pennants, arched gateways, royal parasols, banners, garlands, and the like,
adorned with a variegated canopy, strewn with heaps of scattered flowers.

1.136.s:
tasya madhye kuśāstīrṇe mūrtiḥ sthāpyā vivasvataḥ .
tatrāsyāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā dadyādarghyaṃ vivasvate . . 4
1.136.d:
तस्य मध्ये कुशास्तीर्णे मूर्तिः स्थाप्या विवस्वतः ।
तत्रास्यावाहनं कृत्वा दद्यादर्घ्यं विवस्वते ॥ 4
1.136.m:
In its centre, strewn with kuśa grass, the image of Vivasvat is to be installed.
Having invoked him there, one should offer the respectful water-offering to Vivasvat.

1.136.s:
suvarṇamadhuparkādi kṛtvā1 tatra vidhānataḥ .
devasya darśayedgāṃ ca savatsāṃ rohiṇīṃ śubhām . . 5
1.136.d:
सुवर्णमधुपर्कादि कृत्वा1 तत्र विधानतः ।
देवस्य दर्शयेद्गां च सवत्सां रोहिणीं शुभाम् ॥ 5
1.136.m:
Having duly prepared the golden honey-mixture and other [offerings] there,
one should show the god an auspicious reddish-brown cow accompanied by her calf.

1.136.s:
namo gopataye tubhyaṃ sahasrāṃśo prasīda me .
evamarghyeṇa sammantrya paridhāya ca vāsasī . . 6
1.136.d:
नमो गोपतये तुभ्यं सहस्रांशो प्रसीद मे ।
एवमर्घ्येण सम्मन्त्र्य परिधाय च वाससी ॥ 6
1.136.m:
Saying 'Obeisance to you, lord of rays, thousand-rayed one, be gracious to me',
having thus consecrated [him] with the respectful offering and dressed him in two garments,

1.136.s:
yajñopavītamātithyaṃ tathābhyaṅgaṃ tathaiva ca .
vatsare vatsare tasya navamavyaṅgamāharet . . 7
1.136.d:
यज्ञोपवीतमातिथ्यं तथाभ्यङ्गं तथैव च ।
वत्सरे वत्सरे तस्य नवमव्यङ्गमाहरेत् ॥ 7
1.136.m:
[offering] the sacred thread, hospitality, and likewise unction,
each year one should bring him a new sacred girdle.

1.136.s:
śrāvaṇe māsi rājendra pavitraṃ tasya taddhi vai .
brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā tu varṣevarṣe prayojayet . . 8
1.136.d:
श्रावणे मासि राजेन्द्र पवित्रं तस्य तद्धि वै ।
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयित्वा तु वर्षेवर्षे प्रयोजयेत् ॥ 8
1.136.m:
In the month of Śrāvaṇa, O king of kings, that is indeed his sacred [thread];
having fed the brāhmaṇas, he should apply it year after year.

1.136.s:
avyaṅgaṃ yaduśārdūla śrāvaṇe māsi bhāskaram .
sarvagandhaiḥ samālabhya candanāgurukuṅkumaiḥ . . 9
1.136.d:
अव्यङ्गं यदुशार्दूल श्रावणे मासि भास्करम् ।
सर्वगन्धैः समालभ्य चन्दनागुरुकुङ्कुमैः ॥ 9
1.136.m:
The sacred girdle, O tiger among Yadus, [is given to] Bhāskara in the month of Śrāvaṇa.
Having anointed him with all fragrant substances, with sandalwood, agallochum, and saffron,

1.136.s:
alaṅkārairalaṅkṛtya kusumaiśca sugandhibhiḥ .
mālābhiśca vicitrābhirābaddhābhiranekaśaḥ . . 1.136.10
1.136.d:
अलङ्कारैरलङ्कृत्य कुसुमैश्च सुगन्धिभिः ।
मालाभिश्च विचित्राभिराबद्धाभिरनेकशः ॥ 1.136.10
1.136.m:
adorning him with ornaments and fragrant flowers,
and with many kinds of colourful garlands bound together,

1.136.s:
tato dhūpaṃ nivedyāśu pratimāgre prayatnataḥ .
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣo maṇḍapaṃ ca praveśayet . . 11
1.136.d:
ततो धूपं निवेद्याशु प्रतिमाग्रे प्रयत्नतः ।
सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषो मण्डपं च प्रवेशयेत् ॥ 11
1.136.m:
and then quickly offering incense before the image with diligence,
with 'The thousand-headed Puruṣa...', he should convey [him] into the pavilion.

1.136.s:
namaḥ śambhaveti mantreṇa śayyāyāṃ viniveśayet .
viśvataścakṣurityeva kuryātkamalaniṣkalam . . 12
1.136.d:
नमः शम्भवेति मन्त्रेण शय्यायां विनिवेशयेत् ।
विश्वतश्चक्षुरित्येव कुर्यात्कमलनिष्कलम् ॥ 12
1.136.m:
With the mantra 'Obeisance to Śambhu...', he should place him upon the couch.
With 'Having eyes on all sides...', he should make the lotus unblemished.

1.136.s:
punareva ca vakṣyāmi saṅkalīkaraṇaṃ śubham .
snāpane tu yathākāryaḥ svadehe nyāsa uttamaḥ . . 13
1.136.d:
पुनरेव च वक्ष्यामि सङ्कलीकरणं शुभम् ।
स्नापने तु यथाकार्यः स्वदेहे न्यास उत्तमः ॥ 13
1.136.m:
Now I shall describe the auspicious integration rite:
how, during the bathing, the excellent projection of mantras should be performed upon one's own body,

1.136.s:
pratimāyāṃ tathā kāryo yathā cālambhanaṃ budhaḥ .
oṃ huṃ khaṣolkāya namo mūlamantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ . . 14
1.136.d:
प्रतिमायां तथा कार्यो यथा चालम्भनं बुधः ।
ओं हुं खषोल्काय नमो मूलमन्त्रः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 14
1.136.m:
and how the wise man should perform it upon the image, as well as the touching of it.
'Oṃ huṃ khaṣolkāya namaḥ' is celebrated as the root mantra.

1.136.s:
ādityo'yaṃ svayaṃ devo hyakṣareṇopabṛṃhitaḥ .
oṃkāraṃ vinyasenmūrdhni huṃkāraṃ nāsikopari . . 15
1.136.d:
आदित्योऽयं स्वयं देवो ह्यक्षरेणोपबृंहितः ।
ओंकारं विन्यसेन्मूर्ध्नि हुंकारं नासिकोपरि ॥ 15
1.136.m:
This Āditya is the god himself, magnified by the syllable.
He should deposit the syllable 'oṃ' on the head, and the syllable 'huṃ' upon the nose;

1.136.s:
khakāraṃ ca lalāṭe tu ṣakāraṃ vadane nyaset .
lakāraṃ caiva kaṃṭhe tu kakāraṃ hṛdaye nyaset . . 16
1.136.d:
खकारं च ललाटे तु षकारं वदने न्यसेत् ।
लकारं चैव कंठे तु ककारं हृदये न्यसेत् ॥ 16
1.136.m:
the syllable 'kha' upon the forehead, and he should place the syllable 'ṣa' on the mouth;
the syllable 'la' at the throat, and he should place the syllable 'ka' upon the heart;

1.136.s:
yakāraṃ tu bhuje vāme nakāraṃ dakṣiṇe bhuje .
makāraṃ vāmakukṣau ca visargaṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset .. 17
1.136.d:
यकारं तु भुजे वामे नकारं दक्षिणे भुजे ।
मकारं वामकुक्षौ च विसर्गं दक्षिणे न्यसेत् ॥ 17
1.136.m:
the syllable 'ya' upon the left arm, and the syllable 'na' upon the right arm;
the syllable 'ma' upon the left flank, and he should place the visarga upon the right.

1.136.s:
oṃkāraṃ tu sadā dhyāyejjvālāmālāsamākulam .
huṅkāraṃ śuddhavarṇābhaṃ prasuvantamalaṃ śubham .. 18
1.136.d:
ओंकारं तु सदा ध्यायेज्ज्वालामालासमाकुलम् ।
हुङ्कारं शुद्धवर्णाभं प्रसुवन्तमलं शुभम् ॥ 18
1.136.m:
One should always meditate upon the syllable 'oṃ' as filled with a wreath of flames;
upon the syllable 'huṃ' as shining with a pure hue, bringing forth spotless auspiciousness;

1.136.s:
khakāraṃ cintayetprājño bhinnāñjanasamaprabham .
taruṇādityavarṇābhaṃ khakāraṃ cintayedbudhaḥ .. 19
1.136.d:
खकारं चिन्तयेत्प्राज्ञो भिन्नाञ्जनसमप्रभम् ।
तरुणादित्यवर्णाभं खकारं चिन्तयेद्बुधः ॥ 19
1.136.m:
the wise man should meditate upon the syllable 'kha' as resembling crushed collyrium;
the wise man should meditate upon the syllable 'kha' as having the colour of the morning sun;

1.136.s:
ṣokāraṃ tu mahābāho hemavarṇaṃ vicintayet .
śuklapadmanibhākāramakāraṃ ciṃtayedbudhaḥ ..1.136.20
1.136.d:
षोकारं तु महाबाहो हेमवर्णं विचिन्तयेत् ।
शुक्लपद्मनिभाकारमकारं चिंतयेद्बुधः ॥1.136.20
1.136.m:
the syllable 'ṣo', O mighty-armed one, he should meditate upon as gold-coloured;
and the wise man should meditate upon the syllable 'ma' as having the form of a white lotus;

1.136.s:
jātīkusumasaṃkāśaṃ hrīṃkāraṃ sarvavarṇakam .
kṣīravarṇaṃ sakāraṃ tu cintayetsatataṃ budhaḥ ..2 1
nakāraṃ himakundābhaṃ makāramamṛtākṣaram .
hrīṃkāraṃ vidyutsaṃkāśaṃ hrīṃkāraṃ sarvavarṇakam ..221
1.136.d:
जातीकुसुमसंकाशं ह्रींकारं सर्ववर्णकम् ।
क्षीरवर्णं सकारं तु चिन्तयेत्सततं बुधः ॥2 1
नकारं हिमकुन्दाभं मकारममृताक्षरम् ।
ह्रींकारं विद्युत्संकाशं ह्रींकारं सर्ववर्णकम् ॥221

1.136.s:
kṣīravarṇaṃ sakāraṃ tu cintayetsatataṃ budhaḥ .
nakāraṃ svarṇavarṇābhaṃ makāraṃ kanakaprabham ..23
1.136.d:
क्षीरवर्णं सकारं तु चिन्तयेत्सततं बुधः ।
नकारं स्वर्णवर्णाभं मकारं कनकप्रभम् ॥23
1.136.m:
and the wise man should always meditate upon the syllable 'sa' as milk-coloured;
upon the syllable 'na' as gold-coloured, and upon the syllable 'ma' as having the lustre of gold.

1.136.s:
tato devaṃ mahātmānaṃ sahasrakiraṇaṃ ravim .
prasādābhimukhaṃ devaṃ śayanīye niveśayet ..24
1.136.d:
ततो देवं महात्मानं सहस्रकिरणं रविम् ।
प्रसादाभिमुखं देवं शयनीये निवेशयेत् ॥24
1.136.m:
Then, facing the temple sanctuary, one should place the god,
the great-souled thousand-rayed Sun, upon the couch.

1.136.s:
agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kuryuragnikuṇḍeṣu vai dvijāḥ .
tato'raṇyāṃ samutthāpya agniṃ laukikameva vā ..25
1.136.d:
अग्निकार्यं ततः कुर्युरग्निकुण्डेषु वै द्विजाः ।
ततोऽरण्यां समुत्थाप्य अग्निं लौकिकमेव वा ॥25
1.136.m:
Then the twice-born should perform the fire-offering in the sacrificial pits,
either generating the fire from the fire-sticks or using ordinary secular fire.

1.136.s:
prajvālyāgniṃ vidhānena kuryāddhomaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ .
bahvṛcaḥ pūrvakāṇḍeṣu yāmyāṃ madhyandinastathā ..26
1.136.d:
प्रज्वाल्याग्निं विधानेन कुर्याद्धोमं विचक्षणः ।
बह्वृचः पूर्वकाण्डेषु याम्यां मध्यन्दिनस्तथा ॥26
1.136.m: Having kindled the fire according to the ritual rule, the wise man should offer oblation: / a Ṛgvedic priest in the eastern [pits], and likewise a Mādhyandina priest in the south,

1.136.s:
paścime caiva cchandoga uttare'tharvaṇo mataḥ .
madhye ca bhojakaḥ kuryāddhomaṃ yajñe yaduttama ..27
1.136.d:
पश्चिमे चैव च्छन्दोग उत्तरेऽथर्वणो मतः ।
मध्ये च भोजकः कुर्याद्धोमं यज्ञे यदुत्तम ॥27
1.136.m: and a Sāmavedic priest in the west, while an Atharvan priest is prescribed for the north; / and in the middle, O highest of men, a Bhojaka should offer oblations in the sacrifice.

1.136.s:
śamīpālāśodumbarāṇi hyapāmārgastathaiva ca .
dvādaśa tu sahasrāṇi aṣṭau catvāri eva ca ..28
1.136.d:
शमीपालाशोदुम्बराणि ह्यपामार्गस्तथैव च ।
द्वादश तु सहस्राणि अष्टौ चत्वारि एव च ॥28
1.136.m: [With wood of] śamī, palāśa, udumbara, and likewise apāmārga— / twelve thousand, or eight, or four,

1.136.s:
dve trīṇi ca sahasrāṇi atha vā ekameva hi .
agnirmūrdheti mantreṇa kuṇḍasyālambhanaṃ bhavet ..29
1.136.d:
द्वे त्रीणि च सहस्राणि अथ वा एकमेव हि ।
अग्निर्मूर्धेति मन्त्रेण कुण्डस्यालम्भनं भवेत् ॥29
1.136.m: or two or three thousand, or even just one [thousand]. / With the mantra 'agnirmūrdhā...', the touching of the pit should take place.

1.136.s:
ullikhyābhyukṣya tenaiva agniṃ dūtamiti smṛtāḥ .
sambudhyasvāgne mantreṇa garbhādhānaṃ tu kārayet ..1.136.3 0
sīmanteti punastatra mahāmantreṇa homayet .
jātakarma tathā proktaṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ vidurbudhāḥ . . 31
1.136.d:
उल्लिख्याभ्युक्ष्य तेनैव अग्निं दूतमिति स्मृताः ।
सम्बुध्यस्वाग्ने मन्त्रेण गर्भाधानं तु कारयेत् ॥1.136.3 0
सीमन्तेति पुनस्तत्र महामन्त्रेण होमयेत् ।
जातकर्म तथा प्रोक्तं प्राणायामं विदुर्बुधाः ॥ 31
1.136.m: Having inscribed lines and sprinkled [the pit] with that very [mantra], the [mantras] 'agniṃ dūtam...' are prescribed. / With the mantra 'saṃbudhyasvāgne...', he should perform the garbhādhāna rite; / and then he should offer oblations there with the great mantra 'sīmanta...'; / the wise know the jātakarma rite to be thus proclaimed, along with prāṇāyāma.

1.136.s:
namaḥ svāheti mantreṇa nāmakaraṇameva ca .
annaprāśanamantreṇa annaprāśanamādiśet . . 32
1.136.d:
नमः स्वाहेति मन्त्रेण नामकरणमेव च ।
अन्नप्राशनमन्त्रेण अन्नप्राशनमादिशेत् ॥ 32
1.136.m: With the mantra 'namaḥ svāhā...', he should direct the naming rite itself; / and with the food-feeding mantra, he should direct the first feeding of solid food.

1.136.s:
jyeṣṭhamagreti mantreṇa tena cūḍopakarmaṇi .
vratabandhasya mantreṇa vratabandhaṃ samādiśet . . 33
1.136.d:
ज्येष्ठमग्रेति मन्त्रेण तेन चूडोपकर्मणि ।
व्रतबन्धस्य मन्त्रेण व्रतबन्धं समादिशेत् ॥ 33
1.136.m: With the mantra 'jyeṣṭham agra...', he [performs] the tonsure and sacred study; / with the mantra for the investiture of vows, he should direct the investiture of the vow.

1.136.s:
samāvartanamityeva ākṛṣṇeti ca homayet .
patnīsaṃyojanaṃ caiva svayameva prakalpayet . . 34
1.136.d:
समावर्तनमित्येव आकृष्णेति च होमयेत् ।
पत्नीसंयोजनं चैव स्वयमेव प्रकल्पयेत् ॥ 34
1.136.m: He should offer oblations with 'ā kṛṣṇena...' for the return ceremony; / and he himself should perform the union with a wife.

1.136.s:
agnihotrādikaṃ karma yajñakarmāṇi yāni ca .
mahāvyāhṛtimantreṇa hotavyāni samantataḥ . . 35
1.136.d:
अग्निहोत्रादिकं कर्म यज्ञकर्माणि यानि च ।
महाव्याहृतिमन्त्रेण होतव्यानि समन्ततः ॥ 35
1.136.m: The rites such as the Agnihotra and whatever sacrificial rites [there are] / are to be offered on all sides with the great vyāhṛti mantras.

1.136.s:
mātṝṇāṃ yajñabhūtānāṃ balikarma pradāpayet .
sarvakāmasamṛddhyarthaṃ kārayedadhivāsanam . . 36
1.136.d:
मातॄणां यज्ञभूतानां बलिकर्म प्रदापयेत् ।
सर्वकामसमृद्ध्यर्थं कारयेदधिवासनम् ॥ 36
1.136.m: He should cause the offering rite to be given to the Mothers who have become the sacrifice; / and for the fulfilment of all desires, he should perform the consecration.

1.136.s:
trirātraṃ pañcarātraṃ ca ahorātramathāpi vā .
tataḥ tvalaṅkṛtāṃ snātāṃ maṇiratnairvibhūṣitām . . 37
1.136.d:
त्रिरात्रं पञ्चरात्रं च अहोरात्रमथापि वा ।
ततः त्वलङ्कृतां स्नातां मणिरत्नैर्विभूषिताम् ॥ 37
1.136.m: For three nights, or five nights, or even a day and a night. / Then, adorned, bathed, and ornamented with gems and jewels,

1.136.s:
kṛtarakṣāṃ prayatnena pratimāmadhivāsayet .
devāgārādathaiśāne digbhāge divyamandiram . . 38
1.136.d:
कृतरक्षां प्रयत्नेन प्रतिमामधिवासयेत् ।
देवागारादथैशाने दिग्भागे दिव्यमन्दिरम् ॥ 38
1.136.m: he should carefully consecrate the image for which protection has been performed. / Then, in the north-eastern direction from the temple, having prepared a divine hall,

1.136.s:
kṛtvā kuśaparistīrṇe varāstaraṇasaṃvṛte .
pūrvaśīrṣāṃ tathā śayyāṃ śuklāṃ śuklāmbarottarām . . 39 tasyāmāveśayetsamyaṅmahāśvetamupāharet .
nikṣubhā dakṣiṇe pārśve vāme rājñī ca kīrtitā . . 1.136.40
1.136.d:
कृत्वा कुशपरिस्तीर्णे वरास्तरणसंवृते ।
पूर्वशीर्षां तथा शय्यां शुक्लां शुक्लाम्बरोत्तराम् ॥ 39 तस्यामावेशयेत्सम्यङ्महाश्वेतमुपाहरेत् ।
निक्षुभा दक्षिणे पार्श्वे वामे राज्ञी च कीर्तिता ॥ 1.136.40
1.136.m: strewn with kuśa grass and covered with an excellent mattress, / a white couch with its head to the east and covered with white cloth, / he should properly place [the image] upon it and bring Mahāśveta; / Nikṣubhā is declared on the right side, and Rājñī on the left.

1.136.s:
daṇḍapiṅgalakau cāsya sthitau pādapraveśitau .
tasyāṃ saṃveśitāyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ pratimāṃ raveḥ . . 41
1.136.d:
दण्डपिङ्गलकौ चास्य स्थितौ पादप्रवेशितौ ।
तस्यां संवेशितायां तु शर्वर्यां प्रतिमां रवेः ॥ 41
1.136.m: And his [attendants] Daṇḍa and Piṅgala stand at his feet. / When the image of the sun has been laid down upon it for the night,

1.136.s:
vasettāṃ rajanīṃ tatra stūyamānaścatudiśam .
brāhmaṇairbandibhiścāpi gītajñaiścāraṇaistathā . . 42
1.136.d:
वसेत्तां रजनीं तत्र स्तूयमानश्चतुदिशम् ।
ब्राह्मणैर्बन्दिभिश्चापि गीतज्ञैश्चारणैस्तथा ॥ 42
1.136.m: he should dwell there for that night, being praised on all four sides / by brahmins, bards, and bards skilled in song.

1.136.s:
kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ tatra sūryabhaktisamanvitaiḥ .
prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ bodhayedṛgvidhānataḥ . . 43
1.136.d:
कुर्याज्जागरणं तत्र सूर्यभक्तिसमन्वितैः ।
प्रभातायां तु शर्वर्यां बोधयेदृग्विधानतः ॥ 43
1.136.m: He should keep vigil there together with those devoted to the sun; / and when the night has turned to dawn, he should awaken him according to the Ṛgvedic ritual rule.

1.136.s:
haviṣyaṃ bhoktukāmāṃstu brāhmaṇānbhojakāṃstathā .
dakṣiṇābhiśca sampūjya taiḥ kṛtasvastivācanaḥ . .44
1.136.d:
हविष्यं भोक्तुकामांस्तु ब्राह्मणान्भोजकांस्तथा ।
दक्षिणाभिश्च सम्पूज्य तैः कृतस्वस्तिवाचनः ॥44
1.136.m: Having honoured the brahmins and Bhojakas who wish to eat sacrificial food / with priestly gifts, and having had blessings pronounced by them,

1.136.s:
tato garbhagṛhasthāya madhye kṛtvā tu piṇḍikām .
vidhivattatra sauvarṇaṃ nyasetsaptahayaṃ ratham . .45
1.136.d:
ततो गर्भगृहस्थाय मध्ये कृत्वा तु पिण्डिकाम् ।
विधिवत्तत्र सौवर्णं न्यसेत्सप्तहयं रथम् ॥45
1.136.m: then, having made a pedestal in the middle for [the god] standing in the inner sanctum, / he should duly place there a golden chariot with seven horses.

1.136.s:
sarvabījauṣadhaiścaiva tatra dhṛtvā vidhānavit .
dattvārghyaṃ sthāpayettatra yajamānaḥ sahāyavān . . 46 śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣairjaladhārāsahākṣataiḥ .
kṛtyā puṇyāhaśabdaṃ tu ālayasya pradakṣiṇām . .47
1.136.d:
सर्वबीजौषधैश्चैव तत्र धृत्वा विधानवित् ।
दत्त्वार्घ्यं स्थापयेत्तत्र यजमानः सहायवान् ॥ 46 शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषैर्जलधारासहाक्षतैः ।
कृत्या पुण्याहशब्दं तु आलयस्य प्रदक्षिणाम् ॥47
1.136.m: The ritual expert, holding [an offering] there with all seeds and herbs, / having given water offering, the patron of the sacrifice accompanied by assistants should install [the god] there / amidst the sounds of conches and war drums, accompanied by streams of water and unbroken grains, / having uttered auspicious day blessings and made circumambulation of the temple.

1.136.s:
śubhalagne dine ṛkṣe pūrvāhṇe bhānave kṣaṇe .
muhūrte ca śubhe bhānoḥ pratimāṃ sthāpayedbudhaḥ . .48
1.136.d:
शुभलग्ने दिने ऋक्षे पूर्वाह्णे भानवे क्षणे ।
मुहूर्ते च शुभे भानोः प्रतिमां स्थापयेद्बुधः ॥48
1.136.m: Under an auspicious ascendant, day, and lunar mansion, in the forenoon, at a moment sacred to the sun, / and at an auspicious hour, the wise man should install the image of the sun.

1.136.s:
nādhomukhīṃ nordhvamukhīṃ na pārśvāvanatāṃ tathā .
samāmabhimukhīṃ cemāṃ pratimāṃ tu niveśayet . .49
1.136.d:
नाधोमुखीं नोर्ध्वमुखीं न पार्श्वावनतां तथा ।
समामभिमुखीं चेमां प्रतिमां तु निवेशयेत् ॥49
1.136.m: Neither facing downwards, nor facing upwards, nor tilted to the side; / he should set up this image level and facing forward.

1.136.s:
patnyau cāsya tataḥ samyakpārśvayorviniveśayet .
nikṣubhā dakṣiṇe pārśve rave rājñī tu vāmataḥ . . 1.136.50
1.136.d:
पत्न्यौ चास्य ततः सम्यक्पार्श्वयोर्विनिवेशयेत् ।
निक्षुभा दक्षिणे पार्श्वे रवे राज्ञी तु वामतः ॥ 1.136.50
1.136.m: Then he should properly install his two wives at his sides: / Nikṣubhā on the right side of the sun, and Rājñī on the left.

1.136.s:
tatastadupahārārthaṃ sambhāraṃ prāktamāhṛtaiḥ .
modakāyūṣikāpūpaśaṣkulībhūtaśīrṣakaiḥ . . 51
1.136.d:
ततस्तदुपहारार्थं सम्भारं प्राक्तमाहृतैः ।
मोदकायूषिकापूपशष्कुलीभूतशीर्षकैः ॥ 51
1.136.m: Then, for his offering, with the provisions previously brought— / modakas, soups, cakes, twisted pastries, and round confections,

1.136.s:
kṛśaraiḥ pāyasonmiśraiḥ sarvadikṣu kṣipedbalim .
indrāya devapataye baline vajrapāṇaye . .5 2
śatayajñādhipataye tasmai indrāya te namaḥ .
trātāramindramantreṇa indrasyāvāhanaṃ bhavet . . 53
1.136.d:
कृशरैः पायसोन्मिश्रैः सर्वदिक्षु क्षिपेद्बलिम् ।
इन्द्राय देवपतये बलिने वज्रपाणये ॥5 2
शतयज्ञाधिपतये तस्मै इन्द्राय ते नमः ।
त्रातारमिन्द्रमन्त्रेण इन्द्रस्यावाहनं भवेत् ॥ 53
1.136.m: and spiced rice mixed with milk rice—he should cast the offering in all directions: / 'To Indra, lord of the gods, the mighty one who holds the thunderbolt in hand, / the lord of a hundred sacrifices—to that Indra, homage to you!' / The invocation of Indra should be with the mantra 'trātāram indram...'

1.136.s:
agnaye raktanetrāya jvālāmālārcitāya vai .
śaktihastāya tīvrāya tathā caivājavāhine . .
āgreyyāmagrimantreṇa vahnerāvāhanaṃ smṛtam . . 54
1.136.d:
अग्नये रक्तनेत्राय ज्वालामालार्चिताय वै ।
शक्तिहस्ताय तीव्राय तथा चैवाजवाहिने ॥
आग्रेय्यामग्रिमन्त्रेण वह्नेरावाहनं स्मृतम् ॥ 54
1.136.m: To Agni, who has red eyes, who is worshiped with garlands of flames, / who has a spear in hand, the fierce one, and whose mount is a ram— / in the south-east, the invocation of fire is recorded with the fire mantra.

1.136.s:
daṇḍahastāya kṛṣṇāya mahiṣottamavāhine .
sūryaputrāya devāya dharmarājāya vai namaḥ . . 55
1.136.d:
दण्डहस्ताय कृष्णाय महिषोत्तमवाहिने ।
सूर्यपुत्राय देवाय धर्मराजाय वै नमः ॥ 55
1.136.m: To the one who holds a staff in hand, the dark one, whose mount is the excellent buffalo, / to the god who is the son of the sun, to the King of Dharma, homage!

1.136.s:
yamāya tviti mantreṇa mudrāstasyaiva kīrtitāḥ .
nairṛte khaḍgahastāya nīlalohitakāya ca . . 56
1.136.d:
यमाय त्विति मन्त्रेण मुद्रास्तस्यैव कीर्तिताः ।
नैरृते खड्गहस्ताय नीललोहितकाय च ॥ 56
1.136.m: With the mantra 'yamāya tvā...', his mudrās are proclaimed. / In the south-west, to the one who holds a sword in hand, blue and red,

1.136.s:
sarvabāhyādhipataye virūpākhyāya vai namaḥ .
āyaṃ gauriti mantreṇa nairṛtyāṃ tu prakalpayet ..57
1.136.d:
सर्वबाह्याधिपतये विरूपाख्याय वै नमः ।
आयं गौरिति मन्त्रेण नैरृत्यां तु प्रकल्पयेत् ॥57
1.136.m: to the lord of all the outer [beings], who is named Virūpa, homage! / With the mantra 'āyaṃ gauḥ...', he should perform [the invocation] in the south-west.

1.136.s:
vāruṇyāṃ pāśahastāya varuṇāyeti kalpayet .
mantreṇāvāhanaṃ vidyātpañcanadyaḥ sarasvatīm ..58
1.136.d:
वारुण्यां पाशहस्ताय वरुणायेति कल्पयेत् ।
मन्त्रेणावाहनं विद्यात्पञ्चनद्यः सरस्वतीम् ॥58
1.136.m: In the west, he should invoke Varuṇa, who holds a noose in hand, with 'To Varuṇa...' / He should know the invocation to be with the mantra 'pañca nadyaḥ sarasvatīm...'

1.136.s:
prāṇātmakāya dhūpāya avyaṅgāyānilāya ca .
dhvajahastāya bhīmāya namo gandhavahāya ca ..59
1.136.d:
प्राणात्मकाय धूपाय अव्यङ्गायानिलाय च ।
ध्वजहस्ताय भीमाय नमो गन्धवहाय च ॥59
1.136.m: To the one whose self is breath, to the incense, to the wind that is whole, / to the terrible one who holds a banner in hand, homage to the bearer of fragrance!

1.136.s:
tasyāpyāvāhanaṃ vidyādyaddevādevaheḍanam .
gadāhastāya somāya śuṣmiṇe nṛgatāya ca ..1.136.6 0
gadāpaṭṭiśahastāya somarājāya vai namaḥ .
īśāvāsyaṃ ca guhyā vai somamantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..6 1
caturmukhāya devāya padmāsanagatāya ca .
kṛṣṇājinaniṣaṇṇāya namo lambodarāya ca ..62
1.136.d:
तस्याप्यावाहनं विद्याद्यद्देवादेवहेडनम् ।
गदाहस्ताय सोमाय शुष्मिणे नृगताय च ॥1.136.6 0
गदापट्टिशहस्ताय सोमराजाय वै नमः ।
ईशावास्यं च गुह्या वै सोममन्त्रः प्रकीर्तितः ॥6 1
चतुर्मुखाय देवाय पद्मासनगताय च ।
कृष्णाजिननिषण्णाय नमो लम्बोदराय च ॥62
1.136.m: His invocation too should be known with 'yad devā devaheḍanam...'; / to Soma, who holds a mace in hand, the strong one, who has gone among men, / to the one who holds a mace and a spear in hand, to King Soma, homage! / The Īśāvāsya [and] secret [text] is proclaimed as the Soma mantra. / To the four-faced god, seated on a lotus throne, / seated upon a black antelope skin, and to the pot-bellied one, homage!

1.136.s:
gaṇādhipataye deva nīlakaṇṭhāya śūline .
virūpākṣāya rudrāya trailokyādhipate namaḥ ..
abhi tvā śūra no mantra īśānāya prakalpayet ..6 3
sarvanāgādhirājāya śvetavarṇāya bhogine .
sahasraphaṇine nityamanantāya namonamaḥ ..64
1.136.d:
गणाधिपतये देव नीलकण्ठाय शूलिने ।
विरूपाक्षाय रुद्राय त्रैलोक्याधिपते नमः ॥
अभि त्वा शूर नो मन्त्र ईशानाय प्रकल्पयेत् ॥6 3
सर्वनागाधिराजाय श्वेतवर्णाय भोगिने ।
सहस्रफणिने नित्यमनन्ताय नमोनमः ॥64
1.136.m: To the lord of the hosts, O god, to the blue-throated, trident-bearing, / odd-eyed Rudra, to the sovereign of the three worlds, homage! / With the mantra 'abhi tvā śūra no...', he should perform [the invocation] for Īśāna. / To the sovereign king of all serpents, white-coloured, possessing coils, / with a thousand hoods, homage, homage forever to Ananta!

1.136.s:
namo'stu sarpebhya iti mantraścaiva prakīrtitaḥ .
pañcarātrādibhirnyāso hyaṃganyāsaḥ prayujyate ..65
1.136.d:
नमोऽस्तु सर्पेभ्य इति मन्त्रश्चैव प्रकीर्तितः ।
पञ्चरात्रादिभिर्न्यासो ह्यंगन्यासः प्रयुज्यते ॥65
1.136.m: And the mantra 'namo'stu sarpebhyaḥ...' is proclaimed. / Ritual placement with the Pañcarātra [mantras] and so forth, and placement on the limbs, is performed.

1.136.s:
tathopakṣīrapānaiśca stutistotraiśca bhāskaram .
viprebhyo bhojakebhyaśca tato dadyācca dakṣiṇām ..66
1.136.d:
तथोपक्षीरपानैश्च स्तुतिस्तोत्रैश्च भास्करम् ।
विप्रेभ्यो भोजकेभ्यश्च ततो दद्याच्च दक्षिणाम् ॥66
1.136.m: Likewise, [worshipping] the sun with milk drinks and with praises and hymns, / he should then give priestly gifts to the brahmins and Bhojakas.

1.136.s:
sūryakratuṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ naiva kuryādadakṣiṇam .
sthāpyate'nena vidhinā tadbhaktaiḥ pratimā ca yā ..67
1.136.d:
सूर्यक्रतुं महापुण्यं नैव कुर्याददक्षिणम् ।
स्थाप्यतेऽनेन विधिना तद्भक्तैः प्रतिमा च या ॥67
1.136.m: One should never perform the greatly meritorious sacrifice to the sun without priestly gifts. / And whatever image is installed according to this rule by his devotees,

1.136.s:
sā tu vṛddhikarā nityaṃ sānnidhyācca sadā bhavet .
saptajanmasu teṣāṃ tu na rogāḥ sambhavanti hi ..68
1.136.d:
सा तु वृद्धिकरा नित्यं सान्निध्याच्च सदा भवेत् ।
सप्तजन्मसु तेषां तु न रोगाः सम्भवन्ति हि ॥68
1.136.m: it brings prosperity constantly and ever ensures [his] presence; / indeed, no diseases arise for them throughout seven births.

1.136.s:
upāsate trirātraṃ ye bhānoryātrābhivāsane .
gandhamālyopahāraistu te yānti bhuvanaṃ raveḥ ..69
1.136.d:
उपासते त्रिरात्रं ये भानोर्यात्राभिवासने ।
गन्धमाल्योपहारैस्तु ते यान्ति भुवनं रवेः ॥69
1.136.m: Those who worship for three nights at the preliminary consecration of the procession of the sun / with offerings of scents and garlands go to the realm of the sun.

1.136.s:
ātmīyaṃ parakīyaṃ vā pratimāsthāpanaṃ raveḥ .
yaḥ paśyati pumānbhaktyā sa svarlokamavāpnuyāt . . 1.136.70
1.136.d:
आत्मीयं परकीयं वा प्रतिमास्थापनं रवेः ।
यः पश्यति पुमान्भक्त्या स स्वर्लोकमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 1.136.70
1.136.m: A man who looks with devotion upon the installation of an image of the sun, / whether his own or another's, attains the world of heaven.

1.136.s:
daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ vājapeyaśatasya ca .
phalaṃ prāpnoti puruṣaḥ pratiṣṭhāpya divākaram . . 71
1.136.d:
दशानामश्वमेधानां वाजपेयशतस्य च ।
फलं प्राप्नोति पुरुषः प्रतिष्ठाप्य दिवाकरम् ॥ 71
1.136.m: A man obtains the fruit of ten horse-sacrifices and a hundred vājapeya sacrifices / by establishing the Maker of Day.

1.136.s:
yāvatkīrtiḥ puṇyakṛtā bhānoḥ sthāne niveśite .
tāvatsa tu yaduśreṣṭha sūryaloke mahīyate . . 72
1.136.d:
यावत्कीर्तिः पुण्यकृता भानोः स्थाने निवेशिते ।
तावत्स तु यदुश्रेष्ठ सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥ 72
1.136.m: As long as the fame made by his merit remains in the place established for the Sun, / so long, O best of the Yadus, is he exalted in the world of the Sun.

1.136.s:
sthāpane cāsya vai mantraḥ prokto lokeṣu pūjitaḥ .
dhruvā dyauśca dhruvā pṛthvī dhruvaṃ viśvamidaṃ jagat . .
śreyase yajamānasya tathā tvaṃ dhruvatāṃ vraja . . 73
1.136.d:
स्थापने चास्य वै मन्त्रः प्रोक्तो लोकेषु पूजितः ।
ध्रुवा द्यौश्च ध्रुवा पृथ्वी ध्रुवं विश्वमिदं जगत् ॥
श्रेयसे यजमानस्य तथा त्वं ध्रुवतां व्रज ॥ 73
1.136.m: And the mantra proclaimed for his installation is revered in the worlds: / 'Firm is heaven and firm is the earth, firm is this whole universe; / likewise, attain firmness for the welfare of the patron of the sacrifice.'

1.136.s:
sthāpayitvā raviṃ bhaktyā vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā .
māse māse ṛtuphalaṃ labhante nātra saṃśayaḥ . . 74
1.136.d:
स्थापयित्वा रविं भक्त्या विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा ।
मासे मासे ऋतुफलं लभन्ते नात्र संशयः ॥ 74
1.136.m: Having installed the Sun with devotion through rites observed by the rules, / month after month they obtain the fruit of the seasons; of this there is no doubt.

1.136.s:
ekāhenāpi yadbhānoḥ pūjayā prāpyate phalam .
na tu kratuśatairvīra prāpyate mānavairbhuvi . . 75
1.136.d:
एकाहेनापि यद्भानोः पूजया प्राप्यते फलम् ।
न तु क्रतुशतैर्वीर प्राप्यते मानवैर्भुवि ॥ 75
1.136.m: The fruit that is obtained through worship of the Sun even for a single day / is not attained on earth by mortals through hundreds of sacrificial rites, O hero.

1.136.s:
kṛtvāpi sumahatpāpaṃ yaḥ paścātsevate ravim .
sa yāti sūryalokaṃ tu naro vigatakalmaṣaḥ . . 76
1.136.d:
कृत्वापि सुमहत्पापं यः पश्चात्सेवते रविम् ।
स याति सूर्यलोकं तु नरो विगतकल्मषः ॥ 76
1.136.m: Even having committed a very great sin, a man who afterwards serves the Sun / goes to the world of the Sun, freed from stain.

1.136.s:
na bhavediṣṭakānāṃ ca dravaṇaṃ bhūmisaṃmiti .
svarge mahīyate tāvatkārako devaveśmanaḥ . . 77
1.136.d:
न भवेदिष्टकानां च द्रवणं भूमिसंमिति ।
स्वर्गे महीयते तावत्कारको देववेश्मनः ॥ 77
1.136.m: As long as the melting away of the bricks to the measure of the earth does not take place, / so long is the maker of the house of the god exalted in heaven.

1.136.s:
khaṇḍasphuṭitasaṃskāraṃ kṛtvā yatphalamāpyate .
na tu kratusahasraistu prāpyate phalamuttamam . . 78
1.136.d:
खण्डस्फुटितसंस्कारं कृत्वा यत्फलमाप्यते ।
न तु क्रतुसहस्रैस्तु प्राप्यते फलमुत्तमम् ॥ 78
1.136.m: The fruit that is obtained by restoring broken and cracked [parts] / is not obtained, that supreme fruit, through thousands of sacrificial rites.

1.136.s:
sikatāyāmapi gṛhaṃ yastu kuryādvibhāvasoḥ .
gopateḥ sa priyasadaḥ pragacchedgopatervaram . . 79
1.136.d:
सिकतायामपि गृहं यस्तु कुर्याद्विभावसोः ।
गोपतेः स प्रियसदः प्रगच्छेद्गोपतेर्वरम् ॥ 79
1.136.m: He who constructs a house for the Sun even out of sand / becomes a dear resident of the Lord of Rays, and goes to the supreme abode of the Lord of Rays.

1.136.s:
ityevaṃ suravarasya tasya bhānorbhūtānāṃ sthitinilayaprasūtihetoḥ .
śrībhāgī bhavati naro niketakārī kalpānāṃ vasati śataṃ sa sūryaloke . . 1.136.80
pratiṣṭhāpanavidhivarṇanam
1.136.d:
इत्येवं सुरवरस्य तस्य भानोर्भूतानां स्थितिनिलयप्रसूतिहेतोः ।
श्रीभागी भवति नरो निकेतकारी कल्पानां वसति शतं स सूर्यलोके ॥ 1.136.80
प्रतिष्ठापनविधिवर्णनम्
1.136.m:
In this manner, the man who builds a dwelling for that excellent god, the Sun, the cause of the preservation, dissolution, and origin of all beings, / becomes a possessor of fortune and dwells for a hundred kalpas in the world of the Sun.
Description of the Rite of Installation

1.137.s:
nārada uvāca
yaḥ prāsādaṃ racayati pumāndevatānāṃ prayatnāttatra prītyā sapadi kurute sthāpanāṃ bhānubhaktaḥ .
divyānbhogām̐llabhati ca sadā kāmataścāprameyāṃstānbhuktvāsau punarapi bhaveccakravartī pṛthivyām . . 1
1.137.d:
नारद उवाच
यः प्रासादं रचयति पुमान्देवतानां प्रयत्नात्तत्र प्रीत्या सपदि कुरुते स्थापनां भानुभक्तः ।
दिव्यान्भोगाम्̐ल्लभति च सदा कामतश्चाप्रमेयांस्तान्भुक्त्वासौ पुनरपि भवेच्चक्रवर्ती पृथिव्याम् ॥ 1
1.137.m: Nārada said: / The man who with effort builds a temple for the deities, and, as a devotee of the Sun, immediately performs installation there with love, / obtains divine and immeasurable enjoyments always according to his wish, and having enjoyed them, he becomes once more an emperor on earth.

1.137.s:
ye mānavāstridaśamūrtiniketanāni kurvanti sādhujanadṛṣṭimanoharāṇi .
teṣāṃ mṛte'pyaparamārthamaye śarīre loke paribhramati kīrtimayaṃ śarīram . . 2
1.137.d:
ये मानवास्त्रिदशमूर्तिनिकेतनानि कुर्वन्ति साधुजनदृष्टिमनोहराणि ।
तेषां मृतेऽप्यपरमार्थमये शरीरे लोके परिभ्रमति कीर्तिमयं शरीरम् ॥ 2
1.137.m: Those mortals who build dwellings for the forms of the gods, pleasing to the eyes of virtuous people, / even when their physical body made of untruth has died, their body composed of renown wanders in the world.

1.137.s:
iti te kathitamidaṃ devapūjyasya savituḥ sthāpanamivādhānam .
sādhāraṇaṃ vidhānaṃ śṛṇu devānāṃ pratiṣṭhāpane vīra . . 3
1.137.d:
इति ते कथितमिदं देवपूज्यस्य सवितुः स्थापनमिवाधानम् ।
साधारणं विधानं शृणु देवानां प्रतिष्ठापने वीर ॥ 3
1.137.m: Thus have I told you this installation, like the setting up [of the sacred fires], of Savitṛ, who is worthy of worship by the gods. / Listen, O hero, to the general rule for the installation of the gods.

1.137.s:
snāto bhukto vastrālaṅkṛtakusumairgandhaiḥ pratimāyā āstīrṇāyāṃ śayyāyāṃ sthāpanaṃ kuryāt .
suptāyāṃ tu sa nṛtyagītairjāgaraṇaiḥ samyagevādhivāsya daivajñena pratidiṣṭakāle saṃsthāpanaṃ kuryāt .
abhyarcya kusumagandhānulepanaiḥ śaṅkhatūryanirghoṣaiḥ prādakṣiṇyena nayedāyatanasya prayatnena kṛtvā baliṃ pratimāmabhyarcya brāhmaṇāṃśca sādhūndattvā hiraṇyakalaśaṃ vidhinā nikṣipetpiṃṇḍikāmadhye suśvabhre sthāpakadaivajñadvijānsamyagviśeṣato'bhyarcyākalpāntaṃ bhogī bhavatīha paratra sukhī . .4
1.137.d:
स्नातो भुक्तो वस्त्रालङ्कृतकुसुमैर्गन्धैः प्रतिमाया आस्तीर्णायां शय्यायां स्थापनं कुर्यात् ।
सुप्तायां तु स नृत्यगीतैर्जागरणैः सम्यगेवाधिवास्य दैवज्ञेन प्रतिदिष्टकाले संस्थापनं कुर्यात् ।
अभ्यर्च्य कुसुमगन्धानुलेपनैः शङ्खतूर्यनिर्घोषैः प्रादक्षिण्येन नयेदायतनस्य प्रयत्नेन कृत्वा बलिं प्रतिमामभ्यर्च्य ब्राह्मणांश्च साधून्दत्त्वा हिरण्यकलशं विधिना निक्षिपेत्पिंण्डिकामध्ये सुश्वभ्रे स्थापकदैवज्ञद्विजान्सम्यग्विशेषतोऽभ्यर्च्याकल्पान्तं भोगी भवतीह परत्र सुखी ॥4
1.137.m: Having bathed and eaten, one should make the installation of the image on a spread couch, with garments, ornaments, flowers, and fragrant unguents. / When it has been laid to rest, having properly performed the preliminary consecration through dances, songs, and vigils, one should perform the installation at the time indicated by the astrologer. / Having worshipped it with flowers, fragrances, and unguents, amidst the sounds of conches and musical instruments, one should carefully carry it clockwise around the temple. Having made an offering, having worshipped the image and the virtuous brāhmaṇas, and having given a golden vessel, one should properly deposit it into the cavity in the middle of the pedestal. Having properly and especially worshipped the installing priest, the astrologer, and the twice-born, he becomes an enjoyer of pleasures until the end of a kalpa and remains happy in the other world.

1.137.s:
viṣṇorbhāgavatā matāśca savituḥ śambhoḥ sabhasmadvijā mātṝṇāmapi mātṛmaṇḍalavido viprā vidurbrāhmaṇāḥ .
sarve yasya vimuktaśuklavasanā buddhasya raktāmbarā ye yaṃ devamupāśritāḥ suvidhinā taistasya kāryā kriyā . . 5
1.137.d:
विष्णोर्भागवता मताश्च सवितुः शम्भोः सभस्मद्विजा मातॄणामपि मातृमण्डलविदो विप्रा विदुर्ब्राह्मणाः ।
सर्वे यस्य विमुक्तशुक्लवसना बुद्धस्य रक्ताम्बरा ये यं देवमुपाश्रिताः सुविधिना तैस्तस्य कार्या क्रिया ॥ 5
1.137.m: The Bhāgavatas are recognized for Viṣṇu, and for the Sun and Śambhu the twice-born smeared with ashes; for the Mothers, the learned brāhmaṇas who know the circle of the Mothers; / all [priests] of his are without white garments, [and] of the Buddha they wear red cloth. Those who are devoted to whichever god should perform his rite according to proper rule.

1.137.s:
sāmānyamidaṃ devānāmadhivāsanaṃ bhavati mayā kathitam .
kriyamāṇamidaṃ dṛṣṭvā devānāṃ pratiṣṭhāpanam . .
naro bhaktyā iha kāmānavāpya svargabhājanaṃ bhavati . . 6
1.137.d:
सामान्यमिदं देवानामधिवासनं भवति मया कथितम् ।
क्रियमाणमिदं दृष्ट्वा देवानां प्रतिष्ठापनम् ॥
नरो भक्त्या इह कामानवाप्य स्वर्गभाजनं भवति ॥ 6
1.137.m: This general preliminary consecration of the gods has been related by me. / Having seen this installation of the gods being performed, / a man with devotion attains his desires here and becomes an inheritor of heaven.

1.137.s:
idaṃ te kathitaṃ rājanpratiṣṭhāpanamāditaḥ .
yatkṛtvā savituḥ snānaṃ naro yāti manogatim . . 7
1.137.d:
इदं ते कथितं राजन्प्रतिष्ठापनमादितः ।
यत्कृत्वा सवितुः स्नानं नरो याति मनोगतिम् ॥ 7
1.137.m: This installation has been told to you from the beginning, O king, / performing which [along with] the bath of Savitṛ, a man attains the realm of his desire.

1.137.s:
itthaṃ kuryānnaro bhaktyā savituḥ sthāpanaṃ budhaḥ .
kārayetpurato bhaktayā savituḥ sthāpanaṃ budhaḥ . . 8
1.137.d:
इत्थं कुर्यान्नरो भक्त्या सवितुः स्थापनं बुधः ।
कारयेत्पुरतो भक्तया सवितुः स्थापनं बुधः ॥ 8
1.137.m: Thus should a wise man perform the installation of Savitṛ with devotion; / a wise man should cause the installation of Savitṛ to be done in front with devotion.

1.137.s:
itihāsapurāṇasya śravaṇaṃ pāpanāśanam .
tābhyāṃ hi śravaṇādvīra sānnidhyaṃ yāti bhāskaraḥ . . 9
1.137.d:
इतिहासपुराणस्य श्रवणं पापनाशनम् ।
ताभ्यां हि श्रवणाद्वीर सान्निध्यं याति भास्करः ॥ 9
1.137.m: Listening to the Itihāsas and Purāṇas destroys sins. / Truly, through listening to both of them, O hero, the Sun comes near.

1.137.s:
kṛte tvāyatane tasminye cānye cāpi devatāḥ .
tasmātkāryaṃ budhairnityaṃ dharmaśravaṇamāditaḥ . . 1.137.10
1.137.d:
कृते त्वायतने तस्मिन्ये चान्ये चापि देवताः ।
तस्मात्कार्यं बुधैर्नित्यं धर्मश्रवणमादितः ॥ 1.137.10
1.137.m: When that temple is made, and for whatever other deities there are, / therefore, listening to dharma from the beginning should always be performed by the wise.

1.137.s:
vācakaṃ pūjayitvā tu brāhmaṇānupapūjya ca .
kārayedvācanaṃ vīra pustakasyāgrato raveḥ . . 11
1.137.d:
वाचकं पूजयित्वा तु ब्राह्मणानुपपूज्य च ।
कारयेद्वाचनं वीर पुस्तकस्याग्रतो रवेः ॥ 11
1.137.m: Having worshipped the reciter and having worshipped the brāhmaṇas, / one should cause the recitation of the book to be made in front of the Sun, O hero.

1.137.s:
sarvasvaṃ sthāpake dadyādyatkiñjidgṛhamāgatam .
godānamathavā dadyāttasya cittaṃ prasādayet . . 12
1.137.d:
सर्वस्वं स्थापके दद्याद्यत्किञ्जिद्गृहमागतम् ।
गोदानमथवा दद्यात्तस्य चित्तं प्रसादयेत् ॥ 12
1.137.m: One should give to the installing priest all property, whatever has come into the house, / or one should give the gift of a cow and satisfy his heart.

1.137.s:
ityeṣa kathito vīra pratiṣṭhākalpa āditaḥ .
kṛtvā dṛṣṭvā ca śrutvā ca yaṃ naro'rkamavāpnuyāt . . 13
1.137.d:
इत्येष कथितो वीर प्रतिष्ठाकल्प आदितः ।
कृत्वा दृष्ट्वा च श्रुत्वा च यं नरोऽर्कमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 13
1.137.m: Thus has this ritual of installation been told from the beginning, O hero, / by performing, seeing, and hearing which a man attains the Sun.

1.137.s:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sāmbopākhyāne
pratiṣṭhāpanavidhivarṇanam nāma saptatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ . 137 .
dhvajāropaṇavidhivarṇanam
1.137.d:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे साम्बोपाख्याने
प्रतिष्ठापनविधिवर्णनम् नाम सप्तत्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः । 137 ।
ध्वजारोपणविधिवर्णनम्
1.137.m:
Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Rite of Installation', in the Sāmba narrative, in the seventh kalpa, in the Brāhmaparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Rite of Raising the Banner

1.138.s:
nārada uvāca
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi dhvajāropaṇamuttamam .
yaduktaṃ brahmaṇā pūrvamṛṣabhādhipate puraḥ . . 1
1.138.d:
नारद उवाच
हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि ध्वजारोपणमुत्तमम् ।
यदुक्तं ब्रह्मणा पूर्वमृषभाधिपते पुरः ॥ 1
1.138.m: Nārada said: / Well, I shall tell you the excellent raising of the banner, / which was spoken of formerly by Brahmā before the lord of bulls.

1.138.s:
purā devāsure yuddhe yāni devairjayepsubhiḥ .
kṛtānyupari cihnāni vāhanāni dhvajāni tu . . 2
1.138.d:
पुरा देवासुरे युद्धे यानि देवैर्जयेप्सुभिः ।
कृतान्युपरि चिह्नानि वाहनानि ध्वजानि तु ॥ 2
1.138.m: Formerly, in the war between the gods and the asuras, the signs, vehicles, and banners / were placed above by the gods desirous of victory.

1.138.s:
lakṣmacihnadhvajaṃ keturiti paryāyanāmabhiḥ .
kīrtitaḥ sa ca tasyeha pramāṇaṃ gadataḥ śṛṇu . . 3
1.138.d:
लक्ष्मचिह्नध्वजं केतुरिति पर्यायनामभिः ।
कीर्तितः स च तस्येह प्रमाणं गदतः शृणु ॥ 3
1.138.m: It is praised under the synonymous names of lakṣman, cihna, dhvaja, and ketu; / and hear its measure as I speak of it here.

1.138.s:
dhvajo vaṃśasya kartavyastvaviddha ṛjuravraṇaḥ .
prāsādavyāsa tulyasya dhvajavaṃśapramāṇataḥ . . 4
1.138.d:
ध्वजो वंशस्य कर्तव्यस्त्वविद्ध ऋजुरव्रणः ।
प्रासादव्यास तुल्यस्य ध्वजवंशप्रमाणतः ॥ 4
1.138.m: The banner should be made of bamboo, unperforated, straight, and unblemished; / according to the measure of the bamboo for the banner, it should be equal to the width of the temple.

1.138.s:
devāgārasya ye proktā mañjarīkalaśādayaḥ .
atha vā tatpramāṇastu dhvajadaṇḍaḥ prakīrtitaḥ . . 5
1.138.d:
देवागारस्य ये प्रोक्ता मञ्जरीकलशादयः ।
अथ वा तत्प्रमाणस्तु ध्वजदण्डः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 5
1.138.m: Those that are taught for the house of the god, such as the spire and the water-pot— / or else the staff of the banner is said to be of that measure.

1.138.s:
antargṛhasya yā vedī sūtrataḥ parikalpitā .
tasyā vyāso bhavedvaṃśaḥ prasādasya yadūttama . . 6
1.138.d:
अन्तर्गृहस्य या वेदी सूत्रतः परिकल्पिता ।
तस्या व्यासो भवेद्वंशः प्रसादस्य यदूत्तम ॥ 6
1.138.m: The altar of the inner sanctum which is marked out by measuring string, / its width should be [the length of] the bamboo [staff] of the temple, O best of the Yadus.

1.138.s:
atha vā mūlasūtreṇa yo vyāso'ntargṛhasya tu .
prāsādavyāsa iti te proktaśceha na saṃśayaḥ . . 7
1.138.d:
अथ वा मूलसूत्रेण यो व्यासोऽन्तर्गृहस्य तु ।
प्रासादव्यास इति ते प्रोक्तश्चेह न संशयः ॥ 7
1.138.m: Or whatever width of the inner sanctum is [determined] by the primary cord, / that is declared to you as the width of the temple here, without doubt.

1.138.s:
keturbhavedvaro vaṃśo na nimno na ṛjustathā .
patraṃ dhvaje yugaṃ caiva nalikāpuruṣastathā . . 8
1.138.d:
केतुर्भवेद्वरो वंशो न निम्नो न ऋजुस्तथा ।
पत्रं ध्वजे युगं चैव नलिकापुरुषस्तथा ॥ 8
1.138.m: The ketu should be an excellent bamboo, neither bent downwards nor [crooked, but] straight; / as well as the flag, the yoke, and the tube-man upon the banner.

1.138.s:
caturhastā bhavantyete praśastāḥ kṛṣṇanandana .
aṣṭahastapramāṇastu viṃśārdhasya1 pramāṇataḥ . . 9
1.138.d:
चतुर्हस्ता भवन्त्येते प्रशस्ताः कृष्णनन्दन ।
अष्टहस्तप्रमाणस्तु विंशार्धस्य1 प्रमाणतः ॥ 9
1.138.m: These measuring four cubits are praised, O son of Kṛṣṇa; / but one measuring eight cubits corresponds to the measure of ten [cubits].

1.138.s:
sāmānyo dhvajadaṇḍastu sarvasādhāraṇo mataḥ .
daṇḍapāṇidhvajo yastu smṛtaḥ ṣoḍaśahastavān . . 1.138.10
1.138.d:
सामान्यो ध्वजदण्डस्तु सर्वसाधारणो मतः ।
दण्डपाणिध्वजो यस्तु स्मृतः षोडशहस्तवान् ॥ 1.138.10
1.138.m: The common flagstaff is considered applicable to all; / but the staff of Daṇḍapāṇi's banner is remembered as having sixteen cubits.

1.138.s:
viṃśaddhastātparo daṇḍo na kāryaḥ sarvathā raveḥ .
yugmahastastu kartavyo dhvajadaṇḍo manīṣibhiḥ . . 11
1.138.d:
विंशद्धस्तात्परो दण्डो न कार्यः सर्वथा रवेः ।
युग्महस्तस्तु कर्तव्यो ध्वजदण्डो मनीषिभिः ॥ 11
1.138.m: A staff greater than twenty cubits should never be made for the Sun; / and the banner-staff must be made with an even number of cubits by the wise.

1.138.s:
caturaṅgulavistīrṇaḥ suvṛtto dvyaṅgulopari .
nātisūkṣmo na ca sthūlo na kāryo nataparvakaḥ . . 12
1.138.d:
चतुरङ्गुलविस्तीर्णः सुवृत्तो द्व्यङ्गुलोपरि ।
नातिसूक्ष्मो न च स्थूलो न कार्यो नतपर्वकः ॥ 12
1.138.m: It should be four digits wide, well rounded, [tapering to] two digits at the top; / neither too slender nor thick, and it should not be made with bent joints.

1.138.s:
samaparvātu kartavyaḥ sudṛḍhaḥ sūkṣma eva hi .
vakraḥ putravināśāya savraṇo'rthavināśanaḥ . . 13
1.138.d:
समपर्वातु कर्तव्यः सुदृढः सूक्ष्म एव हि ।
वक्रः पुत्रविनाशाय सव्रणोऽर्थविनाशनः ॥ 13
1.138.m: It should indeed be made with even joints, very firm, and slender. / A crooked one causes the ruin of sons, and one with blemishes ruins wealth.

1.138.s:
rogado yugmahastastu bhinno duḥkhamanantakam .
karoti hāni dharmasya hīno yastu pramāṇataḥ . . 14
1.138.d:
रोगदो युग्महस्तस्तु भिन्नो दुःखमनन्तकम् ।
करोति हानि धर्मस्य हीनो यस्तु प्रमाणतः ॥ 14
1.138.m: [An odd-measured staff] brings disease, an even-cubited one [is sound], but a broken one causes endless sorrow. / One that is deficient in measure causes the loss of religious merit.

1.138.s:
vaiṣamyamasamaparvā dadyātkṛcchramadhonnataḥ .
jayo jayanto jaitreyaḥ4 śatruhantā jayāvahaḥ . . 15
1.138.d:
वैषम्यमसमपर्वा दद्यात्कृच्छ्रमधोन्नतः ।
जयो जयन्तो जैत्रेयः4 शत्रुहन्ता जयावहः ॥ 15
1.138.m: One with uneven joints brings misfortune; one raised at the bottom gives hardship. / Jaya, Jayanta, Jaitreya, Śatruhantṛ, Jayāvaha,

1.138.s:
nandopanandanau caivendropendrau gaditau tathā .
daśaite kīrtitā bhedā dhvajasyānandasammitāḥ . . 16
1.138.d:
नन्दोपनन्दनौ चैवेन्द्रोपेन्द्रौ गदितौ तथा ।
दशैते कीर्तिता भेदा ध्वजस्यानन्दसम्मिताः ॥ 16
1.138.m: Nanda and Upananda, and likewise Indra and Upendra are declared; / these ten varieties of banner are proclaimed, equivalent in joy.

1.138.s:
dvijahastastu jayo daṇḍo jayanto dviguṇo mataḥ .
dvādaśahastastu jaitreyaḥ śatruhantā kalānvitaḥ . . 17
1.138.d:
द्विजहस्तस्तु जयो दण्डो जयन्तो द्विगुणो मतः ।
द्वादशहस्तस्तु जैत्रेयः शत्रुहन्ता कलान्वितः ॥ 17
1.138.m: The Jaya staff is two cubits, Jayanta is considered twice that; / Jaitreya is twelve cubits, and Śatruhantṛ is endowed with sixteen.

1.138.s:
jayāvahastu viṃśārdho nanda ādityasannibhaḥ .
caturdaśopanandastu indraḥ ṣoḍaśa ucyate . . 18
1.138.d:
जयावहस्तु विंशार्धो नन्द आदित्यसन्निभः ।
चतुर्दशोपनन्दस्तु इन्द्रः षोडश उच्यते ॥ 18
1.138.m: Jayāvaha is ten cubits, Nanda is twelve; / Upananda is fourteen, and Indra is said to be sixteen.

1.138.s:
upendro'ṣṭādaśaḥ5 proktastathendro viṃśatiḥ smṛtaḥ .
bhinno vakro'sādhitaśca na kāryo daṇḍa eva hi . . 19
1.138.d:
उपेन्द्रोऽष्टादशः5 प्रोक्तस्तथेन्द्रो विंशतिः स्मृतः ।
भिन्नो वक्रोऽसाधितश्च न कार्यो दण्ड एव हि ॥ 19
1.138.m: Upendra is declared to be eighteen, and Indra is remembered as twenty. / A broken, crooked, and unworked staff must never be made at all.

1.138.s:
mūlamantreṇa kartavyo vyāsato'ntargṛhasya tu .
dhvajadaṇḍo mahābāho atha vā vāstumānataḥ . . 1.138.20
1.138.d:
मूलमन्त्रेण कर्तव्यो व्यासतोऽन्तर्गृहस्य तु ।
ध्वजदण्डो महाबाहो अथ वा वास्तुमानतः ॥ 1.138.20
1.138.m: The banner-staff, O mighty-armed one, should be made with the root-mantra / according to the width of the inner sanctuary, or according to the measurement of the site,

1.138.s:
mañjarīmānato vāpi tadardhenāthavā vibho .
patākā vai śubhā kāryā dhvajavaṃśāvalambinī . . 21
1.138.d:
मञ्जरीमानतो वापि तदर्धेनाथवा विभो ।
पताका वै शुभा कार्या ध्वजवंशावलम्बिनी ॥ 21
1.138.m: or according to the measurement of the spire, or by half of that, O lord. / An auspicious flag should indeed be made, hanging from the banner-bamboo,

1.138.s:
devāgārasya śikharāttribhāgaparimārjanī .
sā proktā daśadhā vīra mānatomānatastathā . . 22
1.138.d:
देवागारस्य शिखरात्त्रिभागपरिमार्जनी ।
सा प्रोक्ता दशधा वीर मानतोमानतस्तथा ॥ 22
1.138.m: sweeping one-third of the roof of the shrine of the deity. / It is declared to be of ten kinds, O hero, both according to standard measure and non-standard measure:

1.138.s:
aṅkuraḥ pallavaścaiva skandhaḥ śākhā tathaiva ca .
patākā kadalī vīra keturlakṣma jayastathā . . 23
1.138.d:
अङ्कुरः पल्लवश्चैव स्कन्धः शाखा तथैव च ।
पताका कदली वीर केतुर्लक्ष्म जयस्तथा ॥ 23
1.138.m: Aṅkura, Pallava, Skandha, and Śākhā, / Patākā, Kadalī, O hero, Ketu, Lakṣman, and Jaya,

1.138.s:
dhvajaśca daśamaḥ proktaḥ sarvadevamayovyayaḥ .
aṅkuro dvayaṃgulaḥ proktaḥ pallavaścaturaṅgulaḥ . . 24
1.138.d:
ध्वजश्च दशमः प्रोक्तः सर्वदेवमयोव्ययः ।
अङ्कुरो द्वयंगुलः प्रोक्तः पल्लवश्चतुरङ्गुलः ॥ 24
1.138.m: and Dhvaja is proclaimed the tenth, imperishable, consisting of all deities. / An Aṅkura is declared to be two digits; a Pallava is four digits;

1.138.s:
skandhaḥ ṣaḍaṅgulaḥ proktaḥ śākhā cāṣṭāṅgulo matā .
ekādaśapatākā tu kadalī ca caturdaśa . . 25
1.138.d:
स्कन्धः षडङ्गुलः प्रोक्तः शाखा चाष्टाङ्गुलो मता ।
एकादशपताका तु कदली च चतुर्दश ॥ 25
1.138.m: a Skandha is declared to be six digits; a Śākhā is regarded as eight digits; / an eleven-[digit] one is a Patākā, and a Kadalī is fourteen;

1.138.s:
ketustu ṣoḍaśaḥ prokto lakṣmāṣṭādaśamucyate .
jayā viṃśati vai proktā etāvattvaṅgulāni tu . . 26
1.138.d:
केतुस्तु षोडशः प्रोक्तो लक्ष्माष्टादशमुच्यते ।
जया विंशति वै प्रोक्ता एतावत्त्वङ्गुलानि तु ॥ 26
1.138.m: a Ketu is declared to be sixteen; a Lakṣman is said to be eighteen; / a Jayā is declared to be twenty—these are the digits.

1.138.s:
devāgārasya kumbhasya prasannā sā pramārjanī .
aṅkureti patākā sā vijñeyā yadunandana . . 27
1.138.d:
देवागारस्य कुम्भस्य प्रसन्ना सा प्रमार्जनी ।
अङ्कुरेति पताका सा विज्ञेया यदुनन्दन ॥ 27
1.138.m: When it sweeps brightly the pot of the god's shrine, / that flag should be known as Aṅkura, O son of Yadu.

1.138.s:
pallaveti dvitīyasya mārjanī parikīrtitā .
tribhāgamārjanīskandhaḥ śākhā vai pañcamasya tu . . 28
1.138.d:
पल्लवेति द्वितीयस्य मार्जनी परिकीर्तिता ।
त्रिभागमार्जनीस्कन्धः शाखा वै पञ्चमस्य तु ॥ 28
1.138.m: For the second, the sweeping flag is proclaimed as Pallava; / Skandha sweeps one-third; Śākhā is for the fifth;

1.138.s:
ṣaṣṭhasyoktā patākā tu kadalī saptamasya tu .
aṣṭamasya tathā keturlakṣma ca navamasya tu . . 29
1.138.d:
षष्ठस्योक्ता पताका तु कदली सप्तमस्य तु ।
अष्टमस्य तथा केतुर्लक्ष्म च नवमस्य तु ॥ 29
1.138.m: Patākā is spoken of for the sixth, Kadalī for the seventh; / likewise Ketu for the eighth, and Lakṣman for the ninth.

1.138.s:
tatastu daśamaḥ prokto jayanto yadunandana .
vṛṣasthānāvamārgī tu dhvajastu parikīrtitaḥ . . 1.138.30
1.138.d:
ततस्तु दशमः प्रोक्तो जयन्तो यदुनन्दन ।
वृषस्थानावमार्गी तु ध्वजस्तु परिकीर्तितः ॥ 1.138.30
1.138.m: Then the tenth is declared to be Jayanta, O son of Yadu; / but the banner [Dhvaja] is celebrated as sweeping down to the place of the bull.

1.138.s:
gajo meṣo'tha mahiṣaḥ kabandhastu vṛṣastathā .
hariṇo'tha naraścaiva naraśca narasattama . . 31
1.138.d:
गजो मेषोऽथ महिषः कबन्धस्तु वृषस्तथा ।
हरिणोऽथ नरश्चैव नरश्च नरसत्तम ॥ 31
1.138.m: The elephant, the ram, then the buffalo, the headless trunk, and the bull, / the deer, and the man, and the man, O best of men—

1.138.s:
sthānānyetāni bhūyo'tha1 prayuktasya dhvajasya tu .
diśabhāge tu pūrvāttu krameṇa parikalpayet . . 32
1.138.d:
स्थानान्येतानि भूयोऽथ1 प्रयुक्तस्य ध्वजस्य तु ।
दिशभागे तु पूर्वात्तु क्रमेण परिकल्पयेत् ॥ 32
1.138.m: these are the places of the banner properly employed; / one should arrange them in succession beginning from the eastern direction.

1.138.s:
evaṃ daśavidhā proktā patākā tattvadarśibhiḥ .
kartavyā sā yathāpūrvaṃ tacchṛṇu tvaṃ narādhipa . . 33
1.138.d:
एवं दशविधा प्रोक्ता पताका तत्त्वदर्शिभिः ।
कर्तव्या सा यथापूर्वं तच्छृणु त्वं नराधिप ॥ 33
1.138.m: Thus the flag has been declared to be of ten kinds by the seers of truth; / hear, O ruler of men, how it is to be made as of old:

1.138.s:
śuklavastramayī citrā saghaṇṭā sumanoharā .
nānācāmarasampannā kiṅkiṇījālamaṇḍitā . . 34
1.138.d:
शुक्लवस्त्रमयी चित्रा सघण्टा सुमनोहरा ।
नानाचामरसम्पन्ना किङ्किणीजालमण्डिता ॥ 34
1.138.m: Made of white cloth, variegated, equipped with bells, very charming, / provided with various chowries, and adorned with a lattice of tiny bells.

1.138.s:
dhvajāgre caiva kartavyo devatāliṅgasūcakaḥ .
kāñcano vātha raupyo vā maṇiratnamayo'pi vā . . 35
1.138.d:
ध्वजाग्रे चैव कर्तव्यो देवतालिङ्गसूचकः ।
काञ्चनो वाथ रौप्यो वा मणिरत्नमयोऽपि वा ॥ 35
1.138.m: At the top of the banner one should make an indicator of the emblem of the deity, / either of gold, or of silver, or made of precious gems;

1.138.s:
raṅgakairlikhyate vāpi tadvāhanasamākṛtiḥ .
dhvajadaṇḍo'tra vinyastaḥ kartavyo yadunandana . . 36
1.138.d:
रङ्गकैर्लिख्यते वापि तद्वाहनसमाकृतिः ।
ध्वजदण्डोऽत्र विन्यस्तः कर्तव्यो यदुनन्दन ॥ 36
1.138.m: or the likeness of its mount is painted with colours. / The banner-staff placed there should be made, O son of Yadu.

1.138.s:
garutmātmāṃstu dhvajo viṣṇorīśvarasya dhvajo vṛṣaḥ .
brahmaṇaḥ paṅkajaṃ kāryaṃ raverdharmaḥ smṛto dhvajaḥ . . 37
1.138.d:
गरुत्मात्मांस्तु ध्वजो विष्णोरीश्वरस्य ध्वजो वृषः ।
ब्रह्मणः पङ्कजं कार्यं रवेर्धर्मः स्मृतो ध्वजः ॥ 37
1.138.m: Garutmān is the banner of Viṣṇu; the bull is the banner of the Lord; / the lotus is to be made for Brahmā; Dharma is remembered as the banner of the Sun;

1.138.s:
haṃso1 jalādhipasyoktaḥ somasya tu naro dhvajaḥ .
baladevasya kālastu kāmasya makaradhvajaḥ . . 38
1.138.d:
हंसो1 जलाधिपस्योक्तः सोमस्य तु नरो ध्वजः ।
बलदेवस्य कालस्तु कामस्य मकरध्वजः ॥ 38
1.138.m: the goose is declared for the lord of waters; a man is the banner of Soma; / the black [serpent / palm] for Baladeva; and Kāma has the makara banner;

1.138.s:
siṃho dhvajastu durgāyāḥ kīrtito yadunandana .
godhā cāpi umādevyā raivatasya hayaḥ smṛtaḥ . . 39
1.138.d:
सिंहो ध्वजस्तु दुर्गायाः कीर्तितो यदुनन्दन ।
गोधा चापि उमादेव्या रैवतस्य हयः स्मृतः ॥ 39
1.138.m: the lion is proclaimed as the banner of Durgā, O son of Yadu; / the monitor lizard of the goddess Umā; the horse is remembered for Raivata;

1.138.s:
kacchapo varuṇasyokto vātasya hariṇo mataḥ .
pāvakasya tathā meṣa ākhurgaṇapatermataḥ . . 1.138.40
1.138.d:
कच्छपो वरुणस्योक्तो वातस्य हरिणो मतः ।
पावकस्य तथा मेष आखुर्गणपतेर्मतः ॥ 1.138.40
1.138.m: the tortoise is declared for Varuṇa; the deer is regarded for the Wind; / likewise the ram for Fire; the rat is regarded for the lord of the Gaṇas;

1.138.s:
brahmarṣīṇāṃ kuśaḥ prokta ityeṣā dhvaja kalpanā .
yasya yadvāhanaṃ proktaṃ tattasya dhvaja ucyate . . 41
1.138.d:
ब्रह्मर्षीणां कुशः प्रोक्त इत्येषा ध्वज कल्पना ।
यस्य यद्वाहनं प्रोक्तं तत्तस्य ध्वज उच्यते ॥ 41
1.138.m: kuśa grass is declared for the Brahmin-seers—such is the design of banners. / Whatever is declared as the mount of each, that is called his banner.

1.138.s:
viṣṇordhvaje tu sauvarṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ .
patākā cāpi pītā syādgaruḍasya samīpagā . . 42
1.138.d:
विष्णोर्ध्वजे तु सौवर्णं दण्डं कुर्याद्विचक्षणः ।
पताका चापि पीता स्याद्गरुडस्य समीपगा ॥ 42
1.138.m: On the banner of Viṣṇu, the wise man should make a golden staff, / and the flag should be yellow, situated near Garuḍa.

1.138.s:
īśvarasya dhvaje daṇḍo rājato yadunandanaḥ .
patākā cāpi śuklā syādvṛṣabhasya samīpagā . . 43
1.138.d:
ईश्वरस्य ध्वजे दण्डो राजतो यदुनन्दनः ।
पताका चापि शुक्ला स्याद्वृषभस्य समीपगा ॥ 43
1.138.m: On the banner of the Lord, the staff is of silver, O son of Yadu, / and the flag should be white, situated near the bull.

1.138.s:
pitāmahadhvaje daṇḍaḥ smṛtastāmramayo budhaiḥ .
padmavarṇā patākā syātpaṅkajasya samīpagā . . 44
1.138.d:
पितामहध्वजे दण्डः स्मृतस्ताम्रमयो बुधैः ।
पद्मवर्णा पताका स्यात्पङ्कजस्य समीपगा ॥ 44
1.138.m: On the banner of the Grandfather, the staff is remembered by the wise to be made of copper; / the flag should be lotus-coloured, situated near the lotus.

1.138.s:
ādityasya ca sauvarṇo dhvaje daṇḍaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .
pañcavarṇā patākā syāddharmasyādhogatā nṛpa . . 45
1.138.d:
आदित्यस्य च सौवर्णो ध्वजे दण्डः प्रकीर्तितः ।
पञ्चवर्णा पताका स्याद्धर्मस्याधोगता नृप ॥ 45
1.138.m: And for the Sun, the staff on the banner is proclaimed to be of gold; / the flag should be of five colours, placed below Dharma, O king,

1.138.s:
kiṅkiṇījālasampannā nānabudbudasannibhā .
puṣpamālopasampannā nānāvādibhirāvṛtā . . 46
1.138.d:
किङ्किणीजालसम्पन्ना नानबुद्बुदसन्निभा ।
पुष्पमालोपसम्पन्ना नानावादिभिरावृता ॥ 46
1.138.m: endowed with a network of tiny bells, resembling various bubbles, / furnished with garlands of flowers, and surrounded by various musical instruments.

1.138.s:
daṇḍa indradhvajasyoktaḥ kāñcano yadunandana .
patākā bahuvarṇā syātkuñjarasya samīpagā . . 47
1.138.d:
दण्ड इन्द्रध्वजस्योक्तः काञ्चनो यदुनन्दन ।
पताका बहुवर्णा स्यात्कुञ्जरस्य समीपगा ॥ 47
1.138.m: The staff of Indra's banner is said to be golden, O son of Yadu; / the flag should be multi-coloured, situated near the elephant.

1.138.s:
āyasaścāpi daṇḍokto yamacihnaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ .
patākā varṇataḥ kṛṣṇā mahiṣasya samīpagā . . 48
1.138.d:
आयसश्चापि दण्डोक्तो यमचिह्नं विचक्षणैः ।
पताका वर्णतः कृष्णा महिषस्य समीपगा ॥ 48
1.138.m: And an iron staff is declared by the wise as the emblem of Yama; / the flag is black in colour, situated near the buffalo.

1.138.s:
jalādhipadhvajo daṇḍo rājataḥ parikīrtitaḥ .
patākā sarvataḥ śvetā vicitrā sā ca kathyate . . 49
1.138.d:
जलाधिपध्वजो दण्डो राजतः परिकीर्तितः ।
पताका सर्वतः श्वेता विचित्रा सा च कथ्यते ॥ 49
1.138.m: The staff of the banner of the lord of waters is proclaimed to be silver; / its flag is said to be white all over and variegated.

1.138.s:
dhvaje cāpi kuberasya daṇḍo maṇimayaḥ smṛtaḥ .
patākā cāpi raktā syānnarapādasamīpagā . . 1.138.50
1.138.d:
ध्वजे चापि कुबेरस्य दण्डो मणिमयः स्मृतः ।
पताका चापि रक्ता स्यान्नरपादसमीपगा ॥ 1.138.50
1.138.m: And on the banner of Kubera, the staff is remembered as made of jewels; / the flag should be red, situated near the feet of the man.

1.138.s:
baladevadhvaje daṇḍo rājato yadunandana .
patākā varṇataḥ śuklā tālasyādhogatā smṛtā . . 51
1.138.d:
बलदेवध्वजे दण्डो राजतो यदुनन्दन ।
पताका वर्णतः शुक्ला तालस्याधोगता स्मृता ॥ 51
1.138.m: On the banner of Baladeva, the staff is of silver, O son of Yadu; / the flag is white in colour, remembered as placed below the palm tree.

1.138.s:
kāmadhvaje trilohaḥ syāddaṇḍo yadukulodvaha .
patākā rohiṇī tatra makarasya samīpagā . . 52
1.138.d:
कामध्वजे त्रिलोहः स्याद्दण्डो यदुकुलोद्वह ।
पताका रोहिणी तत्र मकरस्य समीपगा ॥ 52
1.138.m: On Kāma's banner, the staff should be of three metals, O scion of the Yadu race; / the red flag there is situated near the makara.

1.138.s:
māyūraṃ kārttikeyasya cihnaṃ lokeṣu gīyate .
trilohadaṇḍamārūḍhaṃ bahuratnavibhūṣitam . . 53
1.138.d:
मायूरं कार्त्तिकेयस्य चिह्नं लोकेषु गीयते ।
त्रिलोहदण्डमारूढं बहुरत्नविभूषितम् ॥ 53
1.138.m: The peacock emblem of Kārttikeya is sung in the worlds, / mounted on a staff of three metals, adorned with many jewels.

1.138.s:
bahuvarṇakacitrā tu patākā kathitā budhaiḥ .
hastidantabhavaṃ daṇḍaṃ kuryādgaṇapaternṛpa . . 54
1.138.d:
बहुवर्णकचित्रा तु पताका कथिता बुधैः ।
हस्तिदन्तभवं दण्डं कुर्याद्गणपतेर्नृप ॥ 54
1.138.m: And the flag is described by the wise as variegated with many colours. / O king, one should make the staff of the lord of the Gaṇas from elephant ivory,

1.138.s:
tāmradaṇḍaṃ samāruḍhaṃ saṃśuddhaṃ sampratiṣṭhitam .
śuklā patākā kartavyā supramāṇā mahīpate . . 55
1.138.d:
ताम्रदण्डं समारुढं संशुद्धं सम्प्रतिष्ठितम् ।
शुक्ला पताका कर्तव्या सुप्रमाणा महीपते ॥ 55
1.138.m: or mounted on a copper staff, thoroughly purified and consecrated. / A white flag should be made, well-proportioned, O protector of the earth.

1.138.s:
mātṝṇāṃ cāpi kartavyo naikarūpo dhvajo budhaiḥ .
patākābhiranekābhibarhuratnābhiranvitaḥ . . 56
1.138.d:
मातॄणां चापि कर्तव्यो नैकरूपो ध्वजो बुधैः ।
पताकाभिरनेकाभिबर्हुरत्नाभिरन्वितः ॥ 56
1.138.m: And for the Mothers, a multi-formed banner should be made by the wise, / accompanied by many flags and many jewels.

1.138.s:
revatasyāpi kartavyo dhvajo vājī narādhipa .
raktā patākā tatrāpi kartavyā yadunandana . . 57
1.138.d:
रेवतस्यापि कर्तव्यो ध्वजो वाजी नराधिप ।
रक्ता पताका तत्रापि कर्तव्या यदुनन्दन ॥ 57
1.138.m: And for Revata, O king, a horse should be made [as] the banner; / a red flag also must be made there, O delight of the Yadus.

1.138.s:
cāmuṇḍāmandire kāryaḥ śiromālākulo dhvajaḥ .
nīlā patākā kartavyā daṇḍo lohamayastathā . . 58
1.138.d:
चामुण्डामन्दिरे कार्यः शिरोमालाकुलो ध्वजः ।
नीला पताका कर्तव्या दण्डो लोहमयस्तथा ॥ 58
1.138.m: In the temple of Cāmuṇḍā, a banner crowned with a garland of heads should be made; / a blue flag must be made, and the pole made of iron.

1.138.s:
rītīmayaśca mātṝṇāṃ revatasya ca kārayet .
gauryā dhvajastāmramayaḥ patākā gopasannibhā . . 59
1.138.d:
रीतीमयश्च मातॄणां रेवतस्य च कारयेत् ।
गौर्या ध्वजस्ताम्रमयः पताका गोपसन्निभा ॥ 59
1.138.m: And [a pole] made of brass should be made for the Mothers and for Revata. / For Gaurī, the banner is made of copper, [and] the flag resembles a cowherd.

1.138.s:
svarṇadaṇḍastu vīrasya dhvajo meṣasamanvitaḥ .
patākā bahuratnāḍhye1 kartavyā yadunandana . . 1.138.60
1.138.d:
स्वर्णदण्डस्तु वीरस्य ध्वजो मेषसमन्वितः ।
पताका बहुरत्नाढ्ये1 कर्तव्या यदुनन्दन ॥ 1.138.60
1.138.m: A golden staff is for the Hero, with a ram on the banner; / a flag rich in many jewels must be made, O delight of the Yadus.

1.138.s:
aśmasāramayo daṇḍo dhvajo vātasya ucyate .
patākā kṛṣṇavarṇā tu hariṇasya samīpagā . . 61
1.138.d:
अश्मसारमयो दण्डो ध्वजो वातस्य उच्यते ।
पताका कृष्णवर्णा तु हरिणस्य समीपगा ॥ 61
1.138.m: A pole made of iron is declared for the banner of the Wind, / while the flag is black in colour, positioned near a deer.

1.138.s:
bhagavatyā dhvajo daṇḍaḥ sarvaratnamayaḥ smṛtaḥ .
patākā tu trivarṇā syātsiṃhasyādhogatā nṛpa . . 62
1.138.d:
भगवत्या ध्वजो दण्डः सर्वरत्नमयः स्मृतः ।
पताका तु त्रिवर्णा स्यात्सिंहस्याधोगता नृप ॥ 62
1.138.m: The banner-pole of the Goddess is declared to be made of all jewels; / the flag should be three-coloured, placed beneath a lion, O king.

1.138.s:
evaṃvidhamimaṃ kṛtvā dhvajaṃ lakṣaṇalakṣitam .
adhivāsya tato rājaṃstata āropayedbudhaḥ . . 63
1.138.d:
एवंविधमिमं कृत्वा ध्वजं लक्षणलक्षितम् ।
अधिवास्य ततो राजंस्तत आरोपयेद्बुधः ॥ 63
1.138.m: Having made such a banner marked with these characteristics, / and having performed its consecration, O king, the wise man should then raise it.

1.138.s:
tataḥ sarvauṣadhībhiśca snāpayitvā prayatnataḥ .
samālabhya ca badhnīyānmadhye pratisarānnṛpa . . 64
1.138.d:
ततः सर्वौषधीभिश्च स्नापयित्वा प्रयत्नतः ।
समालभ्य च बध्नीयान्मध्ये प्रतिसरान्नृप ॥ 64
1.138.m: Then, having carefully bathed it with all medicinal herbs, / and anointed it, O king, he should tie protective amulets in the middle.

1.138.s:
kalpayitvā śubhāṃ vediṃ kalaśairupaśobhitām .
tasyāṃ vedyāṃ samāropya tāṃ rātrimadhivāsayet . . 65
1.138.d:
कल्पयित्वा शुभां वेदिं कलशैरुपशोभिताम् ।
तस्यां वेद्यां समारोप्य तां रात्रिमधिवासयेत् ॥ 65
1.138.m: Having prepared an auspicious altar adorned with water jars, / [and] having placed it upon that altar, he should let it dwell [there] for that night.

1.138.s:
nānākusumacitrāṃ ca srajaṃ tasyānulambayet .
samabhyarcya prayatnena dhūpamasya nivedayet . . 66
1.138.d:
नानाकुसुमचित्रां च स्रजं तस्यानुलम्बयेत् ।
समभ्यर्च्य प्रयत्नेन धूपमस्य निवेदयेत् ॥ 66
1.138.m: He should hang upon it a garland variegated with diverse flowers; / having worshipped it diligently, he should offer incense to it.

1.138.s:
balikarma tataḥ kṛtvā kṛśarāpūpakādibhiḥ .
palālapūpikābhiśca dadhipāyasasūpakaiḥ2 . . 67
1.138.d:
बलिकर्म ततः कृत्वा कृशरापूपकादिभिः ।
पलालपूपिकाभिश्च दधिपायससूपकैः2 ॥ 67
1.138.m: Then, having performed the rite of offering with kṛśarā, cakes, and other foods, / and with straw-cakes, curds, milk-rice, and broths,

1.138.s:
uddiśya lokapālebhyo baliṃ dadyācca vāyasaiḥ .
brāhmaṇānsvasti vācyātha kṛtvā puṇyāhamaṅgalam . . 68
1.138.d:
उद्दिश्य लोकपालेभ्यो बलिं दद्याच्च वायसैः ।
ब्राह्मणान्स्वस्ति वाच्याथ कृत्वा पुण्याहमङ्गलम् ॥ 68
1.138.m: he should present an offering designated for the world protectors by means of crows. / Then, having made the brāhmaṇas chant benedictions and having performed the auspicious ceremony for a holy day,

1.138.s:
vāditrakṛtanirghoṣaṃ jalaṃ saṃskārasaṃyutam .
nānābudbudasapannaṃ veṣṭitaṃ navavāsasā . . 69
1.138.d:
वादित्रकृतनिर्घोषं जलं संस्कारसंयुतम् ।
नानाबुद्बुदसपन्नं वेष्टितं नववाससा ॥ 69
1.138.m: with consecrated water resounding with musical instruments, / filled with various bubbles, wrapped with a new garment,

1.138.s:
śubhe lagne dine ṛkṣe dhvajaṃ cāropayedbudhaḥ .
vinyasya svarṇakalaśaṃ śvabhrarājaṃ dhvajasya tu . . 1.138.70
1.138.d:
शुभे लग्ने दिने ऋक्षे ध्वजं चारोपयेद्बुधः ।
विन्यस्य स्वर्णकलशं श्वभ्रराजं ध्वजस्य तु ॥ 1.138.70
1.138.m: under an auspicious ascendant, day, and lunar mansion, the wise man should raise the banner, / having placed a golden jar, the king of pits, for the banner.

1.138.s:
evamāropayedyastu dhvajaṃ devālayopari .
sa śriyā vardhate nityaṃ prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim . . 71
1.138.d:
एवमारोपयेद्यस्तु ध्वजं देवालयोपरि ।
स श्रिया वर्धते नित्यं प्राप्नोति परमां गतिम् ॥ 71
1.138.m: He who raises the banner in this manner upon a temple / ever thrives in prosperity and attains the highest state.

1.138.s:
asurā vāsamicchanti dhvajahīne surālaye .
tasmāddevālayaṃ prājño dhvajahīnaṃ na kārayet . . 72
1.138.d:
असुरा वासमिच्छन्ति ध्वजहीने सुरालये ।
तस्माद्देवालयं प्राज्ञो ध्वजहीनं न कारयेत् ॥ 72
1.138.m: Demons desire to dwell in a temple that is devoid of a banner; / therefore, a wise man must not make a temple devoid of a banner.

1.138.s:
mantraśca sthāpane prokto vidhānajñairdhvajasya tu .
ehyehi bhagavandeva devavāhana vai khaga . . 73
1.138.d:
मन्त्रश्च स्थापने प्रोक्तो विधानज्ञैर्ध्वजस्य तु ।
एह्येहि भगवन्देव देववाहन वै खग ॥ 73
1.138.m: And the mantra for the erection of the banner has been declared by those who know the ritual: / 'Come, come, O Lord, O god, vehicle of the god, O bird!

1.138.s:
śrīkaraḥ śrīnivāsaśca jaya jaitropaśobhita .
vyomarūpa mahārūpa dharmātmaṃstvaṃ ca vai gateḥ . . 74
1.138.d:
श्रीकरः श्रीनिवासश्च जय जैत्रोपशोभित ।
व्योमरूप महारूप धर्मात्मंस्त्वं च वै गतेः ॥ 74
1.138.m: Giver of fortune, abode of Śrī, conqueror, adorned with victory! / Sky-formed, of great form, O righteous one, and thou indeed of motion!

1.138.s:
sānnidhyaṃ kuru daṇḍe'sminsākṣī ca dhruvatāṃ vraja .
kuru vṛddhiṃ sadā kartuḥ prāsādasyārkavallabha . . 75
1.138.d:
सान्निध्यं कुरु दण्डेऽस्मिन्साक्षी च ध्रुवतां व्रज ।
कुरु वृद्धिं सदा कर्तुः प्रासादस्यार्कवल्लभ ॥ 75
1.138.m: Make thy presence in this pole, and as a witness become steadfast; / always grant increase to the builder of the temple, O beloved of the Sun!'

1.138.s:
oṃ ehyehi bhagavannīśvaravinirmita uparicaravāyumārgānusāriñchrīnivāsa ripudhvaṃsa
yakṣanilaya sarvadevapriyaṃ kuru sānnidhyaṃ śānti svastyayanaṃ ca mebhayaṃ sarvavighnā vyapasarantu . . 76
1.138.d:
ओं एह्येहि भगवन्नीश्वरविनिर्मित उपरिचरवायुमार्गानुसारिञ्छ्रीनिवास रिपुध्वंस
यक्षनिलय सर्वदेवप्रियं कुरु सान्निध्यं शान्ति स्वस्त्ययनं च मेभयं सर्वविघ्ना व्यपसरन्तु ॥ 76
1.138.m: 'Om, come, come, O Lord fashioned by Īśvara, moving in the upper air along the path of the wind, abode of Śrī, destroyer of enemies, / dwelling of yakṣas, dear to all the gods, make thy presence! Grant peace, benediction, and freedom from fear to me; let all obstacles depart!'

1.138.s:
mantreṇānena rājendra śvabhre daṇḍe niveśayet .
patākāṃ pūrvamantreṇa sthityā pūrvamukho nṛpa . . 77
1.138.d:
मन्त्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र श्वभ्रे दण्डे निवेशयेत् ।
पताकां पूर्वमन्त्रेण स्थित्या पूर्वमुखो नृप ॥ 77
1.138.m: With this mantra, O ruler of kings, he should insert the pole into the pit; / facing east, O king, he should place the flag with the previous mantra.

1.138.s:
kṣipedūrdhvamathākāśaṃ prāsādaśikharādvibhoḥ .
yajamānastataḥ paśyetpatākāṃ yadunandana . . 78
1.138.d:
क्षिपेदूर्ध्वमथाकाशं प्रासादशिखराद्विभोः ।
यजमानस्ततः पश्येत्पताकां यदुनन्दन ॥ 78
1.138.m: He should cast [it] upward into the sky from the spire of the temple of the Lord. / Then the patron of the sacrifice should look upon the flag, O delight of the Yadus.

1.138.s:
prāsādapurato vāpi patākāṃ pātayedyadi .
indralokaṃ tadā kartā viśedvai yadunandana . . 79
1.138.d:
प्रासादपुरतो वापि पताकां पातयेद्यदि ।
इन्द्रलोकं तदा कर्ता विशेद्वै यदुनन्दन ॥ 79
1.138.m: If he should drop the flag in front of the temple, / then the builder would enter the world of Indra, O delight of the Yadus.

1.138.s:
āgneyyāmagnilokaṃ tu yāmyāṃ yamasado bhajet .
naiṛtyāṃ naiṛtaṃ lokaṃ vāruṇyaḥ vāruṇaṃ vrajet . . 1.138.80
1.138.d:
आग्नेय्यामग्निलोकं तु याम्यां यमसदो भजेत् ।
नैऋत्यां नैऋतं लोकं वारुण्यः वारुणं व्रजेत् ॥ 1.138.80
1.138.m: In the southeast, he would enjoy the world of Agni; in the south, the abode of Yama; / in the southwest, the world of the Nairṛtas; in the west, he would go to the world of Varuṇa.

1.138.s:
yasya devasya yadveśma kṛtaṃ yadukulodvaha .
tasya lokamavāpnoti vṛṣasthānagato yadi . . 81
1.138.d:
यस्य देवस्य यद्वेश्म कृतं यदुकुलोद्वह ।
तस्य लोकमवाप्नोति वृषस्थानगतो यदि ॥ 81
1.138.m: Whatever temple has been made for whichever deity, O uplifter of the Yadu race, / he attains that deity's world, if it goes to the place of the bull.

1.138.s:
vāyavye vāyumāpnoti saumyāyāṃ somamāpnuyāt .
aiśānyāmīśamāpnoti kartā vai devaveśmanaḥ . . 82
1.138.d:
वायव्ये वायुमाप्नोति सौम्यायां सोममाप्नुयात् ।
ऐशान्यामीशमाप्नोति कर्ता वै देववेश्मनः ॥ 82
1.138.m: In the northwest, he attains Vāyu; in the north, he would attain Soma; / in the northeast, he attains Īśa—the builder of the temple of the god.

1.138.s:
ya evaṃ kārayedbhaktyā dhvajasyāropaṇaṃ raveḥ .
sa hi bhuktvā parānbhogānsūryaloke mahīyate . . 83
1.138.d:
य एवं कारयेद्भक्त्या ध्वजस्यारोपणं रवेः ।
स हि भुक्त्वा परान्भोगान्सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥ 83
1.138.m: He who thus causes the raising of the Sun's banner to be performed with devotion, / having enjoyed supreme pleasures, is honoured in the world of the Sun,

1.138.s:
tejasāmbujasaṃkāśaḥ kāntyā cāmbujasannibhaḥ .
dvijātitulyaḥ prabhayā vikrameṇa ca gopateḥ . . 84
1.138.d:
तेजसाम्बुजसंकाशः कान्त्या चाम्बुजसन्निभः ।
द्विजातितुल्यः प्रभया विक्रमेण च गोपतेः ॥ 84
1.138.m: resembling a lotus in splendour, and like a lotus in beauty, / equal to the twice-born in radiance, and [equal] to the lord of the rays in prowess.

1.138.s:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sāmbopākhyāne
dhvajāropaṇavidhivarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ . 138 .
bhojakānayanavarṇanam
1.138.d:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे साम्बोपाख्याने
ध्वजारोपणविधिवर्णनं नामाष्टत्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः । 138 ।
भोजकानयनवर्णनम्
1.138.m:
Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-eighth chapter, named 'Description of the Rite of Raising the Banner', in the Sāmbopākhyāna in the Saptamīkalpa of the Brāhmaparvan in the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of Bringing the Bhojakas
